articles.title: Language model capabilities fail in a shared, predictable order under compression and perturbation
articles.abstract: Compression can preserve a language model's average accuracy while selectively degrading individual capabilities. Whether these losses follow method-specific patterns or a transferable order is unclear. We applied seven perturbation and compression methods to eight instruction-tuned models, scoring 16 tasks in four answer formats against preregistered predictions. Short-answer capabilities failed in nearly the same order under four random perturbations with different mechanisms (median correlation 0.90) and, within each model, under pruning and quantization (0.875). Intact answer margin, answer frequency and answer format predicted this order. Fragility profiles measured under random perturbation predicted which tasks and facts compression removes first and, after four-task calibration, held-out task accuracy (median absolute error 0.11-0.12, against 0.20-0.21 for uniform decline); profiles borrowed from other model families did almost as well. The order did not transfer across models under GPTQ quantization or hold for long-form tasks. Within short answers, what compression removes is predictable before deployment.

articles.titleCn: 在压缩和扰动下，语言模型的能力以共享的、可预测的顺序失效。
articles.abstractCn: 压缩可以在一定程度上保持语言模型的平均准确率，同时有选择性地降低某些特定能力。这些损失是否遵循特定方法的模式或可迁移的顺序尚不明确。我们对八个指令微调模型应用了七种扰动和压缩方法，在四种答案格式下对16项任务进行评分，并与预先注册的预测结果进行对比。在四种具有不同机制的随机扰动下，短答案能力几乎以相同的顺序失效（中位数相关性为0.90），并且在每个模型内部，通过剪枝和量化处理后也是如此（0.875）。完整的答案边距、答案频率和答案格式预测了这种顺序。在随机扰动下测量的脆弱性特征预测了压缩首先移除哪些任务和事实，并且在经过四项任务校准后，保持了留出任务的准确率（中位数绝对误差为0.11-0.12，而均匀下降的误差为0.20-0.21）；从其他模型家族借用的特征几乎同样有效。这种顺序在GPTQ量化下没有跨模型迁移，并且不适用于长文本任务。在短答案中，压缩移除的内容在部署前即可预测。

articles.title: The Average Patient: Do Simulated Psychiatric Patients Answer Like Real People?
articles.abstract: Language models are used as simulated psychiatric patients to train clinicians and evaluate AI therapists, and are judged by plausibility or total scores. We give a framework for simulated respondents: an information budget bounds how much simulated patients can differ, and an average-patient hypothesis, that a model answers each item at the level typical of the named condition and severity, implies little variation, a full profile of the condition's typical symptoms and totals at or above the top of the stated severity band. We examine these implications at matched totals on item-level data from eight human samples, including a clinical and an instructed-feigning sample. Across 17 models, simulated patients vary 1.5 to 11 times less than real respondents with the same total and on most questionnaires endorse nearly every symptom at a middling level; on the PHQ-9 their symptoms covary less like real ones. People, honest or feigning, answer "not at all" about as often as genuine patients with the same totals, and more often than every model. Single answers are highly concentrated, and prompt changes, published personas, larger models and reasoning reduce the pattern without removing it. In interviews, patients told a severity are rated as having nearly every symptom, so an assessment agent's recognition of absent symptoms goes untested, and scored against the stated severity the agent places a quarter of them in their band, against about half of patients given a real symptom profile. Having the model word such a profile restores half to two thirds of the variation.
articles.titleCn: 普通患者：模拟精神科患者是否像真人一样回答？
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型被用作模拟精神病患者，以培训临床医生和评估人工智能治疗师，并通过可信度或总分进行评判。我们为模拟受访者提供了一个框架：信息预算限制了模拟患者可以偏离的程度，而平均患者假设——即模型针对每个项目回答的水平符合所命名条件和严重程度的典型水平——意味着变化很小，即完整呈现了该条件的典型症状，且总分在所述严重程度范围顶部或以上。我们在来自八个人类样本（包括临床样本和指导性伪装样本）的项目级数据上匹配总分时检验了这些影响。在17个模型中，模拟患者的变化程度比具有相同总分的真实受访者低1.5至11倍，并且在大多数问卷中几乎在每个症状上都以中等水平作答；在PHQ-9问卷中，他们的症状与真实患者的关联性较低。无论是诚实回答还是伪装回答的人，回答“完全不是”的频率与具有相同总分的真实患者相似，并且比所有模型更频繁。单个回答高度集中，提示改变、已发布的角色、更大的模型和推理会减少这种模式，但不会消除它。在访谈中，告知严重程度的患者被认为几乎具有所有症状，因此评估代理对缺失症状的识别能力未被测试，并且根据所述严重程度评分，代理将其中四分之一归入其范围，而大约一半具有真实症状特征的患者被归入该范围。让模型用这种方式描述特征可以使变化恢复到一半到三分之二。

articles.title: ODSA: Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation
articles.abstract: Test-time scaling improves the accuracy of a language model's answers by spending more computation at inference time. Established methods do so either sequentially, revising a single solution over several passes, or in parallel, generating several independent solutions and selecting among them. We present ODSA (Orchestrated Discovery and Self-Aggregation), an LLM-directed scaling framework in which an orchestrator LLM is given existing test-time scaling methods as actions --- discovery of a new independent solution, comparison of existing solutions to build a better one, and acceptance of a proposed answer, which triggers its verification --- and directs stateless workers to carry them out. The orchestrator does not solve the problem itself: it allocates computation, feeds the results of earlier actions into later ones, and takes every action from a single context, so that each decision is informed by everything tried before. On Humanity's Last Exam, ODSA improves accuracy by 4.7 to 18.0 points across three models over a single direct call to the model with no test-time scaling. On LiveCodeBench, where a single direct call already solves most problems, it improves accuracy by 0.6 to 14.0 points.
articles.titleCn: ODSA：协调发现与自聚集
articles.abstractCn: 测试时缩放通过在推理时投入更多计算来提高语言模型答案的准确性。现有方法要么顺序地执行，通过多次迭代来修正单个解决方案，要么并行地执行，生成多个独立的解决方案并从中选择。我们提出了ODSA（协调发现与自我聚合），这是一个由大型语言模型（LLM）指导的缩放框架，其中协调器LLM被赋予现有的测试时缩放方法作为动作——发现新的独立解决方案、比较现有解决方案以构建更好的解决方案、以及接受提出的答案，该答案会触发其验证——并指导无状态工作节点执行这些动作。协调器本身不解决问题：它分配计算资源，将早期动作的结果输入到后期动作中，并从单一上下文中执行每个动作，以便每个决策都能基于之前尝试的所有内容。在《人类最后考试》中，ODSA在三个模型上通过一次直接调用模型且不使用测试时缩放，将准确性提高了4.7到18.0分。在LiveCodeBench上，即使单次直接调用已经能解决大多数问题，它仍将准确性提高了0.6到14.0分。

articles.title: Perturbing Inputs Improves Pretraining Distillation
articles.abstract: Knowledge distillation trains a student language model to match a teacher's predictions on the training text. We ask whether learning the teacher's behavior beyond the training text can further improve the student. We investigate this using three input perturbations: additive token noise, blending two documents, and blending neighboring tokens. Specifically, for an early part of pretraining we perturb the inputs and train the student to match the teacher on them, and we spend the rest of the same token budget on ordinary distillation. When pretraining from scratch, the best method improves on standard distillation at both scales we tried, by 0.025 nats at 135M parameters and by 0.020 nats at 0.5B (mean of three seeds). At 135M this is 1.45 times the gain that distillation itself provides over next-token training. We also observe promising downstream transfer: at 0.5B, the best variant improves average zero-shot accuracy by about one percentage point across seven tasks. It also retains its validation-loss advantage after low-bit weight quantization. We also test a data-limited setting in which training data must be reused, and find that the gains persist. Finally, ablations suggest that, for additive noise, perturbing the teacher's inputs contributes most of the gain, while perturbing only the student's inputs yields much less.

articles.titleCn: 扰动输入可提升预训练蒸馏效果
articles.abstractCn: 知识蒸馏通过训练学生语言模型来匹配教师在训练文本上的预测。我们探讨了是否可以通过学习教师行为（超出训练文本范围）来进一步提升学生模型。我们通过三种输入扰动方法进行研究：添加标记噪声、混合两篇文档以及混合相邻标记。具体而言，在预训练的早期阶段，我们对输入进行扰动，并训练学生模型以匹配教师在这些扰动输入上的表现，而将剩余的相同标记预算用于常规蒸馏。从头开始进行预训练时，最佳方法在两种我们测试的规模上均优于标准蒸馏，在1.35亿参数时提升了0.025奈特，在5亿参数时提升了0.020奈特（三个种子的平均值）。在1.35亿参数时，这一提升是蒸馏本身相对于下一标记训练带来的1.45倍增益。我们还观察到有前景的下游迁移：在5亿参数时，最佳变体在七个任务上平均零样本准确率提升了约一个百分点。它在对低比特权重量化后仍保持了验证损失的领先优势。我们还测试了数据受限的设置，其中训练数据必须被重复使用，发现增益依然存在。最后，消融实验表明，对于添加噪声，扰动教师的输入贡献了大部分增益，而仅扰动学生的输入则贡献较少。

articles.title: Out of Parameters, Saved by Syntax: UD-PrMPT for Parser Augmented Low Resource Machine Translation
articles.abstract: Recent work advancing machine translation quality using LLMs for very low resource languages has relied on the injection of lexicon-based prompt components to expose vocabulary to models. However, these approaches run into a ceiling when models must guess sentence meaning purely from plausible combinations of possible word senses mapped to strings. In this paper we test UD-PrMPT, an approach using syntactic analyses in the Universal Dependencies formalism as prompt components to improve MT in five diverse low resource languages: Beja, Chintang, Chukchi, Coptic, and Xibe. Our results show additive improvements which stack on top of the lexicon based approach which are stronger for higher quality manual analyses but consistent for predicted parses as well.
articles.titleCn: 参数之外，语法拯救：UD-PrMPT用于增强低资源机器翻译的解析器
articles.abstractCn: 近期利用大型语言模型提升极低资源语言机器翻译质量的研究，依赖于注入基于词汇的提示组件来向模型展示词汇。然而，当模型必须纯粹从可能词义组合映射到字符串的合理组合中猜测句子意义时，这些方法会遇到瓶颈。在本文中，我们测试了UD-PrMPT方法，该方法使用通用依赖语法形式化中的句法分析作为提示组件，以提升五种不同极低资源语言的机器翻译质量：贝贾语、钦塘语、楚科奇语、科普特语和锡伯语。我们的结果表明，这些改进在基于词汇的方法之上叠加，对于更高质量的人工分析效果更强，但对于预测的句法分析也具有一致性。

articles.title: LAION-Audio-XL: A Web-Scale Corpus and Scaling Studies for Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining
articles.abstract: Recent progress on contrastive audio-language models can be attributed mainly to the scale and quality of their training data. Larger training datasets expose models to a broader range of sounds and corresponding audio captions. To exploit this, we collect 1.48 billion audio samples from academic datasets, internet datasets, web collections, Common Crawl, and YouTube, and process them with a multi-stage curation pipeline. Furthermore, we generate short and long captions for samples in our corpus that lack them. We use our dataset to study the scaling behavior of contrastive audio-language models based on the NaFlex architecture for the audio encoder. Our experiments identify trade-offs between model size and training data for a given compute budget. Moreover, our resulting models, CLAP2, outperform prior audio-text models of comparable size on the MAEB and HEAR benchmarks. We release our dataset, captions, model checkpoints, and code.

articles.titleCn: LAION-Audio-XL：一个面向大规模语料库和对比语言音频预训练扩展研究的网络规模语料库
articles.abstractCn: 对比音频语言模型近期进展主要归功于其训练数据规模和质量。更大的训练数据集使模型接触到更广泛的音效及其对应的音频字幕。为利用这一优势，我们从学术数据集、互联网数据集、网络集合、Common Crawl 和 YouTube 收集了 14.8 亿个音频样本，并使用多阶段筛选流程进行处理。此外，我们为语料库中缺少字幕的样本生成了短字幕和长字幕。我们使用该数据集研究基于音频编码器 NaFlex 架构的对比音频语言模型的扩展行为。实验识别了在给定计算预算下模型规模与训练数据之间的权衡。此外，我们生成的模型 CLAP2 在 MAEB 和 HEAR 基准测试中优于同等规模的先前音频文本模型。我们发布了数据集、字幕、模型检查点和代码。

articles.title: FinCutBench: A Continually Updated Benchmark for Measuring the Temporal Boundaries of LLM Financial Knowledge
articles.abstract: In financial backtesting and other point-in-time tasks, external inputs can be restricted by date, but model parameters may retain financial facts disclosed later, introducing parametric look-ahead bias. We introduce FinCutBench, a continually updated monthly financial knowledge benchmark for measuring how far a fixed model's financial knowledge extends over calendar time. The current dataset contains 9,000 Chinese and English four-option multiple-choice questions from January 2023 to September 2026, covering Chinese and U.S. markets and four categories of financial information. We construct monthly knowledge profiles using the approximate months in which the tested facts became public. After a profile passes the decline test and knot checks, we define the FinCut Boundary as the first month when the fitted profile reaches its lower level, and report the stability of the estimated date under resampling. Boundary dates and localization precision vary across models. Using the independently measured Transition Start and Boundary as fixed references for downstream sample grouping, we find clear relative declines after the Boundary in U.S. asset ranking and earnings recall for some models, while Chinese-market ranking estimates vary across models and all eight disclosure-period-paired forecast-error comparisons have unadjusted $p$ values above 0.10. The FinCut Boundary thus provides an empirical reference for the temporal scope of parametric knowledge in point-in-time financial evaluation, supporting evaluation-window selection and result interpretation.

articles.titleCn: FinCutBench：一个持续更新的用于衡量LLM金融知识时间边界的基准
articles.abstractCn: 在金融回测及其他时点任务中，外部输入可按日期限制，但模型参数可能保留后续披露的金融事实，从而引入参数性前瞻偏差。我们引入FinCutBench，这是一个持续更新的月度金融知识基准，用于衡量固定模型的金融知识在日历时间上的延伸范围。当前数据集包含2023年1月至2026年9月的9000道中英文四选一选择题，涵盖中国和美国市场以及四种金融信息类别。我们使用测试事实公开的大致月份构建月度知识图谱。在图谱通过衰减测试和节点检查后，我们将FinCut边界定义为拟合图谱达到其低水平的第一个月份，并报告该估计日期在重采样下的稳定性。边界日期和定位精度因模型而异。使用独立测量的转换起始点和边界作为下游样本分组的固定参考，我们发现某些模型在美国资产排名和收益回忆在边界后出现明显相对下降，而中国市场排名估计因模型而异，且所有八组披露期配对预测误差比较的未调整p值均高于0.10。因此，FinCut边界为时点金融评估中参数性知识的时效范围提供了实证参考，支持评估窗口选择和结果解释。

articles.title: Continuous modeling of manipulative participation for stance analysis: Online discourse on the 2024 Street Animal Law in Türkiye
articles.abstract: Studies of online political discourse commonly infer public opinion through stance analysis while implicitly assuming that observed user participation is authentic. Meanwhile, studies focusing on detecting manipulative participation are typically modeling it as a binary phenomenon, overlooking the varying degrees to which users may engage in coordinated or inauthentic behavior. This study proposes a continuous modeling approach for manipulative participation and examines its integration with stance analysis. Using online discourse on the 2024 Street Animal Law in Türkiye as a case study, we collected a dataset comprising 7,320,574 tweets from 537,994 users. From this corpus, 301 users were selected through a high-information sampling strategy and manually annotated by domain experts using a 10-criterion rubric that yields user-level continuous manipulative participation scores. Evaluation under a unified user-level cross-validation protocol showed that the proposed framework accurately estimates both manipulative participation and user stance, with gradient boosting methods providing the best manipulative participation estimates and BERTurk achieving the highest stance classification performance. External validation on an independently annotated user set demonstrated good generalization performance. The findings support modeling manipulative participation as a continuous construct rather than a binary label, providing a more informative basis for computational analyses of the relationship between manipulative participation and stance in online political discourse.

articles.titleCn: 操控参与行为的连续建模用于立场分析：土耳其2024年街头动物法的在线讨论
articles.abstractCn: 对网络政治话语的研究通常通过立场分析来推断公众意见，同时隐含地假设观察到的用户参与是真实的。与此同时，专注于检测操纵性参与的研究通常将其建模为二元现象，忽略了用户可能参与协调或非真实行为的不同程度。本研究提出了一种连续建模方法来处理操纵性参与，并探讨了其与立场分析的整合。以土耳其2024年街头动物法相关的网络话语为案例研究，我们收集了一个包含7,320,574条推文、来自537,994名用户的数据库。从该语料库中，通过高信息采样策略选择了301名用户，并由领域专家使用包含10项标准的评分量表进行人工标注，从而获得用户级别的连续操纵性参与分数。在统一的用户级别交叉验证协议下进行评估表明，所提出的框架能够准确估计操纵性参与和用户立场，其中梯度提升方法提供了最佳的操纵性参与估计，而BERTurk实现了最高的立场分类性能。在独立标注的用户集上进行的外部验证显示了良好的泛化性能。研究结果表明，将操纵性参与建模为连续结构而非二元标签更为合理，为计算分析网络政治话语中操纵性参与与立场之间的关系提供了更丰富的依据。

articles.title: Beyond the Transcript: Measuring and Improving the Use of Acoustic Information in Audio Language Models
articles.abstract: Audio language model benchmarks provide comprehensive evaluation across diverse tasks. However, some tasks can be answered from the transcript or even the question alone, and benchmark scores can therefore confound acoustic understanding with language modeling ability. We distinguish lexical tasks, for which the transcript usually suffices, from global-attribute and within-recording-structure tasks, which require the model to analyse the recording beyond its words, either as a whole, for properties such as the speaker and emotion, or within it, for patterns such as stress and intonation. We evaluated 19 open models and Gemini 3.1 Pro on 92 tasks from 6 benchmarks and estimated the recording gain, the accuracy advantage of the original recording over references that retain its words, by comparing the recording with synthetic readings of its transcript and by adding it to the transcript. On attribute and structure tasks, the open models fall behind Gemini by 28.6 and 41.9 percentage points, and about half or more of each deficit lies in the recording gain. Nevertheless, linear probes in Gemma-4 12B and Qwen2.5-Omni-7B show that the acoustic information needed for answering is already readable in early language-model layers, while the readout of many cues declines in the layers that follow. We therefore constructed training data and trained LoRA adapters in these layers, with a content anchor, which raises attribute and structure accuracy by 12.8 to 44.4 points in the two models and keeps mean lexical accuracy within 1 point of the base model. Most of the improvement appears as larger recording gains. These results suggest that training improves the use of acoustic information that the models already encode.
articles.titleCn: 超越转录文本：测量和改进音频语言模型中声学信息的使用
articles.abstractCn: 音频语言模型基准测试在多样化任务中提供全面评估。然而，某些任务仅从文本或问题本身即可回答，因此基准分数可能将声学理解与语言建模能力混淆。我们将文本通常足够应对的词汇任务，与需要模型超越其词汇分析录音的整体属性任务（如说话人和情绪）或录音内部结构任务（如重音和语调模式）区分开来。我们评估了19个开源模型和Gemini 3.1 Pro在6个基准测试的92个任务上的表现，通过将录音与其文本合成朗读进行比较，以及将其添加到文本中，估算了录音增益，即原始录音相对于保留其词汇的参考的准确度优势。在属性和结构任务中，开源模型比Gemini落后28.6和41.9个百分点，其中每项不足的一半或更多在于录音增益。然而，Gemma-4 12B和Qwen2.5-Omni-7B中的线性探针表明，用于回答的声学信息已在早期语言模型层中可读，而许多线索在后续层中的可读性下降。因此，我们构建了训练数据并在这些层中训练LoRA适配器，使用内容锚点，这两个模型的属性和结构准确度分别提高了12.8到44.4个百分点，并将平均词汇准确度保持在基准模型1个百分点的范围内。大部分改进表现为更大的录音增益。这些结果表明，训练改进了模型已编码的声学信息的利用。

articles.title: When Should Diffusion Language Models Reconsider Their Commitments?
articles.abstract: Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) are well known for fast text generation via parallel decoding. However, independent parallel sampling can commit to inconsistent predictions, and less is known about how to selectively revise these early token commitments. In this work, we introduce $\underline{\mathrm{P}}$lanned $\underline{\mathrm{U}}$nmasking-and-$\underline{\mathrm{R}}$evision Joint $\underline{\mathrm{L}}$earning (PURL) for MDMs, a training-based framework that seamlessly unifies parallel generation with selective token revision. We derive a normalized joint transition whose likelihood factorizes into edit selection, unmask selection, and token prediction. These components are trained jointly on partially masked sequences constructed according to the model's own unmasking policy. During inference, all three decisions are supported by a single shared forward pass, enabling the model to decode masked tokens and revise noisy tokens. Across logic puzzles, mathematical reasoning, and code generation, PURL improves accuracy at matched unmask budgets, with relative gains up to 47.4% accuracy improvement and up to an $8\times$ reduction in scheduled decoding rounds. Beyond these gains, our analysis further reveals general principles of revisable decoding: token edits become more effective as context accumulates; early edits can steer unfinished trajectories, whereas later edits tend to remain localized; and effective edits therefore depend on both calibrating when to intervene and learning where and how to revise. Together, these suggest that effective parallel generation depends not on revising more tokens, but on making the right commitments revisable at the right time.
articles.titleCn: 扩散语言模型何时应重新审视其承诺？
articles.abstractCn: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）以其通过并行解码实现快速文本生成而闻名。然而，独立的并行采样可能导致不一致的预测，而关于如何选择性地修正这些早期标记承诺的研究则相对较少。在这项工作中，我们为MDMs引入了$\underline{\mathrm{P}}$lanned $\underline{\mathrm{U}}$nmasking-and-$\underline{\mathrm{R}}$evision Joint $\underline{\mathrm{L}}$earning（PURL），这是一个基于训练的框架，能够无缝地将并行生成与选择性标记修正相结合。我们推导出一个归一化的联合转换，其似然分解为编辑选择、掩码选择和标记预测。这些组件在根据模型自身掩码策略构建的部分掩码序列上进行联合训练。在推理过程中，所有三个决策都由单个共享的前向传递支持，使模型能够解码掩码标记并修正噪声标记。在逻辑谜题、数学推理和代码生成任务中，PURL在匹配的掩码预算下提高了准确率，相对提升高达47.4%的准确率提升，并减少了高达8倍的调度解码轮次。除此之外，我们的分析进一步揭示了可修正解码的一般原则：随着上下文的积累，标记编辑的效果会增强；早期的编辑可以引导未完成的轨迹，而晚期的编辑往往保持局部化；因此，有效的编辑取决于何时介入以及如何和在哪里进行修正。综合来看，这些发现表明，有效的并行生成并不依赖于修正更多标记，而在于在正确的时间将正确的承诺设为可修正。

articles.title: Safeguarding Agentic AI in Radiology Workflows: A Multimodel Evaluation of Rule-based and Large Language Model-based Verification
articles.abstract: Purpose: To estimate how often tool-using large language model (LLM) agents record clinically relevant false or unsupported information in simulated radiology documentation and how much safeguards applied before each action reduce these errors. Materials and Methods: In this simulation study (October 2026), 48 synthetic, radiologist-reviewed base scenarios covered finding communication, tumor board preparation and follow-up management. Forty-three also had a misleading-information variant (91 variants). Six LLM agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, GLM-5.3, MiniMax M3, Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.8-27B) completed each variant with permissions only, deterministic rules, and rules plus a locally run LLM checker (1638 episodes). The primary outcome was at least one executed high-severity violation per episode. Risk differences were estimated per agent at base-scenario level and, exploratorily, pooled across agents, with analyses of document access and blocks. Results: With permissions only, 7.3%-27.1% of episodes had a high-severity violation (pooled across agents, 19.4%). Pooled, it was 16.7% with rules (-2.8 percentage points; 95% CI: -6.1, 0.5) and 13.2% with rules plus the LLM checker (-6.2; 95% CI: -9.5, -3.0). Adding the LLM checker to rules changed it by -3.5 (95% CI: -6.3, -0.7). No difference between agents was detected (P = .43), and task success did not decrease detectably. In misleading variants, agents opened the altered document in 83% of episodes regardless of error, and 58% of erroneous statements cited it. Most blocked actions (64%-68%) would not have caused a violation and were returned for revision. Conclusion: Layered safeguards reduced but did not prevent high-severity errors. Errors after misleading information reflected misjudged rather than missed information.

articles.titleCn: 在放射科工作流程中保障自主型人工智能：基于规则和大型语言模型的验证的多模型评估
articles.abstractCn: 目的：评估在使用工具的大型语言模型（LLM）代理在模拟放射学文档中记录临床相关错误或不支持信息的频率，以及每次行动前应用的防护措施如何减少这些错误。材料与方法：在本项模拟研究（2026年10月进行）中，48个由放射科医师审阅的合成基础场景涵盖了发现沟通、肿瘤委员会准备和随访管理。其中43个场景还包括误导性信息变体（91个变体）。六个LLM代理（Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1-Sol、GLM-5.3、MiniMax M3、Gemma-4-31B、Qwen3.8-27B）在仅授权、确定性规则以及规则加本地运行的LLM检查器（1638个场景）下完成每个变体。主要结果是每个场景至少执行一次高严重性违规。在基础场景层面，按代理估计风险差异，并探索性地跨代理合并分析，同时分析文档访问和阻止情况。结果：仅授权时，7.3%-27.1%的场景存在高严重性违规（跨代理合并，19.4%）。合并数据显示，规则下为16.7%（-2.8个百分点；95% CI：-6.1, 0.5），规则加LLM检查器下为13.2%（-6.2；95% CI：-9.5, -3.0）。加入LLM检查器使规则变化为-3.5（95% CI：-6.3, -0.7）。未发现代理间的差异（P = .43），任务成功率未明显降低。在误导性变体中，无论是否存在错误，代理在83%的场景中打开修改后的文档，其中58%的错误陈述引用了该文档。大多数阻止行动（64%-68%）不会导致违规，并返回供修订。结论：分层防护措施减少了但未阻止高严重性错误。误导性信息后的错误反映了判断失误而非信息遗漏。

articles.title: Does Merge Form a Hopf Algebra? Coproducts, Traces, and the Prospects of Algebraic Minimalism
articles.abstract: Marcolli, Chomsky, and Berwick (2025; henceforth MCB) formulate the Merge operation of Minimalism on a Hopf algebra of Connes-Kreimer type, and claim that language and physics obey the same algebraic structure. This paper separates their program into the working hypothesis H, that Merge on workspaces can be described as a Hopf algebra, and the claim P placed on top of it, that language and physics obey the same principle, and examines the validity of H. MCB employs two coproducts in formulating Merge, corresponding to two different translations of movement (Internal Merge): $Δ_d$, which deletes the lower copy, and $Δ_c$, which leaves a trace. MCB uses the former in syntax and the latter at the syntax-semantics interface, but $Δ_d$ is not coassociative, and $Δ_c$ is not connected under the gradings MCB gives and, moreover, not coassociative as long as the labels of traces are retained. Consequently, MCB's algebra is not a Hopf algebra, and the Birkhoff factorization is not a consequence of the Hopf-algebra theorem but of a weaker statement that requires neither coassociativity nor connectedness. There are four ways to recover a Hopf algebra, but none of them can distinguish different traces, and hence none is compatible with Heim-Kratzer-style formal semantics, which reads traces as indexed variables. Thus H does not hold at present, and under the current formulation, making Minimalism a Hopf algebra and preserving its connection with formal semantics are mutually exclusive. Finally, we indicate three directions in which algebraic Minimalism may proceed.
articles.comment: 15 pages
articles.titleCn: 合并是否形成Hopf代数？陪积、迹与代数极简主义的展望
articles.abstractCn: 马尔科利、乔姆斯基和伯里克（2025年；以下简称MCB）在康奈斯-克雷默类型的Hopf代数上构建了极小主义中的Merge运算，并声称语言和物理学遵循相同的代数结构。本文将他们的计划分为工作假设H，即Merge在工作空间中可以描述为Hopf代数，以及置于其上的断言P，即语言和物理学遵循相同的原则，并检验H的有效性。MCB在构建Merge时使用了两个积，对应于两种不同的运动（内部Merge）的翻译：Δ_d，它删除了较低副本，而Δ_c，它留下痕迹。MCB在句法中使用前者，在句法-语义界面使用后者，但Δ_d不具有可结合性，而Δ_c在MCB给出的标度下不具有连通性，而且只要保留痕迹的标签，它也不具有可结合性。因此，MCB的代数不是Hopf代数，Birkhoff分解不是Hopf代数定理的推论，而是源于一个更弱的不需要可结合性或连通性的陈述。有四种方法可以恢复Hopf代数，但它们都不能区分不同的痕迹，因此它们都与海姆-克拉特泽风格的正式语义不兼容，后者将痕迹读作索引变量。因此，H目前不成立，在当前表述下，使极小主义成为Hopf代数并保持其与正式语义的联系是相互排斥的。最后，我们指出了代数极小主义可能发展的三个方向。

articles.title: TID System for Speech-COSER Challenge 2026: ASR Track
articles.abstract: We describe the system submitted by Telefónica Innovación Digital to the Speech-COSER Challenge 2026, which features spontaneous speech from elderly speakers recorded in rural Spain. For ASR, we perform CTC-based pseudo-forced alignment scores audio-text match quality to guide a two-stage LoRA curriculum, followed by post-hoc magnitude pruning of the LoRA matrices to enhance generalization. An ensemble of seven systems combined via ROVER achieves 36.25\% unnormalized and 22.17\% normalized WER.
articles.comment: TID system for Speech-COSER Challenge 2026
articles.titleCn: 2026年语音-COSER挑战赛TID系统：语音识别赛道
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了Telefónica Innovación Digital为Speech-COSER Challenge 2026提交的系统，该系统包含在西班牙农村地区录制的老年人自发性语音。在语音识别方面，我们通过基于CTC的伪强制对齐分数音频-文本匹配质量来指导两阶段LoRA课程，随后对LoRA矩阵进行后处理幅度剪枝以增强泛化能力。通过ROVER组合的七个系统实现了36.25%未归一化及22.17%归一化WER。

articles.title: THEATRON: A Benchmark for Evaluating Persona Persistence in Long-Horizon LLM Decision-Making
articles.abstract: Existing evaluations often test persona expression rather than whether persona information persists in extended decision-making. We introduce THEATRON, a controlled benchmark that uses financial replay to evaluate persona persistence in long-horizon sequential decision-making. In these environments, models conditioned on fixed behavioral-finance personas observe shared daily market evidence and trajectory-specific account-state feedback and make sequential decisions over multi-month trajectories. We evaluate Zero-Shot, One-Shot, and Chain-of-Thought persona injection across four LLMs, using cumulative-return and action trajectories to diagnose within-persona stability, cross-persona separability, and action collapse. Persona conditioning produces systematic behavioral shifts beyond a no-persona baseline, and persona-level separation generally exceeds the variation induced by semantically equivalent descriptions. Nevertheless, these shifts do not reliably form coherent persona-specific policies: apparently stable separation can arise from stereotyped action collapse, while diverse policies can exhibit noisy trajectory switching. These findings expose a gap between observable persona-induced behavior and persistent, context-sensitive persona-conditioned decision policies. Code and benchmark data are publicly available at: https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron
articles.titleCn: THEATRON：一个用于评估长时程LLM决策中角色持续性的基准
articles.abstractCn: 现有的评估往往侧重于测试角色表达，而非角色信息是否在长期决策中持续存在。我们引入THEATRON，这是一个使用金融重放进行控制的基准，用于评估长期序列决策中角色持续性的方法。在这些环境中，基于固定行为金融角色的模型观察共享的每日市场证据和特定轨迹的账户状态反馈，并在多个月份的轨迹上进行序列决策。我们评估了四种大型语言模型中的零样本、单样本和思维链角色注入，使用累积回报和行动轨迹来诊断角色内部稳定性、角色间可分离性和行动崩溃。角色条件化产生了超越无角色基线的系统性行为变化，而角色级别的分离通常超过了由语义等价描述引起的变异。然而，这些变化并不能可靠地形成连贯的角色特定策略：看似稳定的分离可能源于刻板印象的行动崩溃，而不同的策略可能表现出噪声轨迹切换。这些发现揭示了可观察的角色诱导行为与持续、上下文敏感的角色条件化决策策略之间的差距。代码和基准数据可在以下网址公开获取：https://github.com/yuyan12138/theatron

articles.title: Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M: One Small Embedder for Tajik, Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz
articles.abstract: The small open embedder EmbeddingGemma-300M, used as released, finds the right passage first for only 51.7% to 60.8% of Belebele questions in Tajik, Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz. We present Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M, one model for all four languages. It is our Tajik fine-tune of EmbeddingGemma-300M, trained for one more epoch on 279,904 pairs: questions in Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz that our own language model wrote about source passages, a Tajik refresher, and English and Russian replay. On Belebele, recall@1 rises by 14.4 to 26.0 points in each language, to between 75.2% and 77.7%. Against single-language models trained with the same settings, the one model stays within 2.8 points at recall@1 in Kazakh, Uzbek and Tajik, with overlapping recall@10 intervals, though it also had more training. It keeps the Tajik law recall@10 of its starting point (92.2 against 92.4) but loses 4.4 points of law recall@1. A model trained on one of these languages also improves the others on Belebele, but less than training on them. The model still trails the 560M XLM-RoBERTa embedders on Kazakh, Uzbek and Kyrgyz Belebele: the better of multilingual-e5-large-instruct and BGE-M3, used as released, is 9.4 to 10.2 points ahead at recall@1. Our scores of those released models agree with the published MTEB results within 2.4 points. Russian and English recall@1 fall by 3.0 and 4.2 points.
articles.comment: 12 pages, 6 tables, 2 figures. Technical report. Model: https://huggingface.co/Tohirju/Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M
articles.titleCn: Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M：一个用于塔吉克语、哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和吉尔吉斯语的通用嵌入模型
articles.abstractCn: 小型开放嵌入器EmbeddingGemma-300M，按原版使用，在塔吉克语、哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和吉尔吉斯语的Belebele问题中，仅对51.7%至60.8%的问题找到正确段落。我们提出了Saidzoda-CA-EmbeddingGemma-300M，一个适用于四种语言的模型。这是我们对EmbeddingGemma-300M的塔吉克语微调版本，在279,904对数据上进行了一轮额外的训练：包括我们自己的语言模型针对源段落撰写的哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和吉尔吉斯语问题，塔吉克语复习材料，以及英语和俄语重播。在Belebele上，每种语言的recall@1提升了14.4至26.0个百分点，达到75.2%至77.7%。与使用相同设置训练的单语模型相比，该多语言模型在哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和塔吉克语的recall@1上保持在2.8个百分点以内，recall@10区间重叠，尽管它接受了更多的训练。该模型保持了其起点塔吉克语的recall@10（92.2对比92.4），但在recall@1上损失了4.4个百分点。在上述语言之一上训练的模型也能在Belebele上提升其他语言的性能，但提升幅度小于在所有这些语言上训练的效果。该模型在哈萨克语、乌兹别克语和吉尔吉斯语的Belebele上仍落后于560M XLM-RoBERTa嵌入器：多语言e5-large-instruct和BGE-M3中表现更好的模型，在recall@1上领先9.4至10.2个百分点。我们发布的这些模型的得分与已发表的MTEB结果在2.4个百分点内一致。俄语和英语的recall@1分别下降了3.0和4.2个百分点。

articles.title: Vietnamese Legal Ontology: Every legal answer, traced to the article that grounds it
articles.abstract: A legal answer is only as good as the article it rests on. Vietnam's largest open legal corpus pairs 109,543 published questions and answers with 573,851 legal documents, yet its citations are free text: "Khoan 3 Dieu 101 cua Bo luat nay" ("Clause 3, Article 101 of this Code") names neither the code nor its version. Following the five stages of NVIDIA Auto Ontology, Discover, Ground, Validate, Expose and Learn, we turn four open datasets into a knowledge graph of 11.5 M nodes and 16.0 M edges in which every node and edge carries its source record and method, with no duplicate keys, dangling edges or schema violations. Of 67,868 cited provisions, 61,487 resolve to a dated law version, 51,694 to a parsed article, clause or point, and 19,012 are confirmed word for word. The ontology then shows what flat records hide. 36% of the 78,361 answers whose citations resolve now cite a law that is no longer in force; 2,525 verified citations point to an article number that says something else in the current law; 2,520 citations were re-versioned because their words match a different version than their date suggests; and 5,575 document numbers are shared by several local authorities, one of them by 72. Every number in this paper is computed from the graph.
articles.titleCn: 越南法律本体：每个法律答案均可追溯到为其提供依据的条款
articles.abstractCn: 一个法律答案的好坏取决于其依据的法律条文。越南最大的公开法律数据库将109,543个已发布的问题与答案配对了573,851份法律文件，但其引用格式为自由文本："Khoan 3 Dieu 101 cua Bo luat nay"（"本法的第101条第3款"）并未指明法律名称及其版本。遵循NVIDIA Auto Ontology的五个阶段——Discover（发现）、Ground（关联）、Validate（验证）、Expose（展示）和Learn（学习），我们将四个公开数据集转化为一个包含1.15亿节点和1.60亿边的知识图谱，其中每个节点和边都携带其来源记录和方法，且无重复键、悬空边或模式违规。在67,868个被引用的条款中，61,487个对应于特定年份的法律版本，51,694个对应于解析后的条款或点，19,012个被确认为逐字引用。该本体揭示了扁平记录所隐藏的问题：在78,361个被引用的答案中，36%的引用指向已失效的法律；2,525个经验证的引用指向现行法律中含义不同的条款编号；2,520个引用因文字与日期所暗示的版本不符而被重新版本化；5,575个文件编号被多个地方当局共享，其中有一个被72个当局共享。本文中的所有数据均基于该图谱计算得出。

articles.title: Modeling individual and item differences in atypicality inferences with ACT-R
articles.abstract: Humans engage in pragmatic reasoning when encountering mentions of highly predictable events. Such mentions may appear redundant, leading comprehenders to infer that the event is atypical, and accommodate this inference with an explanation for why it is atypical. However, these inferences are not drawn uniformly across individuals, and experimental items vary in inference rates due to differences in event typicality. We show that these patterns can be predicted with a resource-rational cognitive model in which comprehenders select interpretation strategies based on individual exploration tendencies and item-level predispositions. These parameters are estimated independently from participants' Raven's Matrices score, event typicality rating and language model based accommodation likelihood. Taken together with recent findings from reference games, our results motivate a new perspective on the mechanisms that support pragmatic inferences.
articles.comment: Accepted as a conference paper at CogSci 2026
articles.titleCn: 使用ACT-R对典型性推断中的个体和项目差异进行建模
articles.abstractCn: 人类在遇到高度可预测事件时进行语用推理。这类提及可能显得冗余，导致理解者推断该事件非典型，并为其非典型性提供解释。然而，这些推断在不同个体间并非一致，且由于事件典型性差异，实验项目的推断率也各不相同。我们表明，这些模式可以通过一个资源理性的认知模型预测，该模型中理解者根据个体探索倾向和项目层面的倾向性选择解释策略。这些参数独立地从参与者的瑞文渐进矩阵得分、事件典型性评分和基于语言模型的适应可能性中估计。结合近期参考游戏的发现，我们的结果为支持语用推理的机制提供了新的视角。

articles.title: Search-by-Answer Bias in Retrieval Models
articles.abstract: Dense retrievers are meant to select passages that match a query's semantic specification. We show they suffer from search-by-answer bias: they favor passages that mention answer objects the model knows (scores as likely), over passages that support valid alternative answers. We test this with controlled factual contrasts from LAMA/TREx. For each retriever, we measure how strongly the model scores the canonical object over an alternative object using a token-prediction head, and ask whether this score predicts passage rankings. Across eight retrievers, including DPR, Spider variants, Contriever, E5, and Qwen3-Embedding, larger token-prediction scores consistently predict higher retrieval scores for passages containing the corresponding object. This holds when passages differ only in the answer object, and even when the passage that mentions the high-scoring object expresses a wrong relation. Dense retrieval thus exhibits search-by-answer bias during passage selection, shaping which evidence is retrieved.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 9 figures
articles.titleCn: 检索模型中的按答案搜索偏差
articles.abstractCn: 密集检索器旨在选择与查询语义规范相匹配的段落。我们展示了它们存在“按答案检索”偏差：它们倾向于选择提及模型已知答案对象（评分较高）的段落，而非支持有效替代答案的段落。我们通过LAMA/TREx中的受控事实对比来验证这一点。对于每个检索器，我们使用一个标记预测头测量模型在标准对象和替代对象上的评分差异，并询问该评分是否预测了段落排名。在包括DPR、Spider变体、Contriever、E5和Qwen3-Embedding在内的八个检索器中，更高的标记预测评分始终预测了包含相应对象的段落具有更高的检索分数。即使当段落仅因答案对象不同，或提及高评分对象的段落表达错误关系时，这一规律依然成立。密集检索在段落选择过程中表现出“按答案检索”偏差，从而决定了哪些证据被检索出来。

articles.title: What Travels Across Languages? Reading, Transfer and Erasure of Cross-Lingual Concept Subspaces in Bangla Idioms
articles.abstract: Cross-lingual concept analysis requires distinguishing the information that a subspace retains from the classifiers and erasers that transfer through it. We study these operations in six frozen encoders using 10,359 Bangla (Bengali) idiom senses, eight input conditions, and figurative-class and sentiment labels. Class-mean directions provide the most consistent evidence of shared coarse meaning: in post hoc analyses, they outperform random-subspace, permuted-label and covariance-matched nulls in all 12 model-label tests under balanced accuracy. A prospective internal re-split supports idiom-alone sharing in 10 of 12 tests, spanning five encoders. The original confirmatory logistic-regression family rejects both planned nulls in 4 of 12 tests, where English directions gain only a few accuracy points above the majority-class floor (3.0-7.3). Classifier transfer depends on the input map and regularization: English-trained class-mean readouts beat both zero-shot nulls in 8 of 12 discovery tests, and stronger source-selected penalties improve transfer through logistic and LEACE directions. These readouts use Bangla-validation-selected layers and unlabeled target preprocessing. Input controls show greater coarse-class sharing for explicit glosses than for idiom counterparts. Reading, however, does not imply effective erasure: English-fitted LEACE removes less than one percentage point of Bangla figurative-class accuracy, compared with 4-11 points for Bangla-fitted LEACE; INLP shows a similar asymmetry. Pattern-filter analysis, covariance-weighted input maps and a binary Gaussian overlap bound explain how these operations can diverge. The analogous multiclass ordering is an empirical diagnostic, observed in 11 of 12 cells. The results support an estimator-sensitive account of cross-lingual concept sharing and motivate evaluating reading, classifier transfer, erasure and overlap separately.
articles.comment: 73 pages, 21 figures, 52 tables. Code, frozen analysis plans and aggregate results: https://github.com/Starscream-11813/bangla-idiom-subspaces
articles.titleCn: 跨语言之旅：孟加拉谚语中跨语言概念子空间的阅读、迁移与消融
articles.abstractCn: 跨语言概念分析需要区分子空间保留的信息以及通过该子空间转移的分类器和擦除器。我们使用10,359个孟加拉语（孟加拉）习语概念、八个输入条件以及比喻类和情感标签，在六个冻结编码器中研究了这些操作。类别均值方向提供了共享粗略含义的最一致证据：在事后分析中，它们在所有12个模型-标签测试中均优于随机子空间、标签置换和协方差匹配的零假设，在平衡精度下表现最佳。一项前瞻性内部重新划分支持了12项测试中的10项习语单独共享，涵盖五个编码器。原始的确认性逻辑回归家族在12项测试中的4项中否定了两个计划零假设，其中英语方向仅比多数类基准高出几个精度点（3.0-7.3）。分类器转移取决于输入映射和正则化：英语训练的类别均值读数在12项发现测试中的8项中优于两个零样本零假设，更强的源选择惩罚通过逻辑和LEACE方向提高了转移。这些读数使用孟加拉语验证选择的层和未标记目标预处理。输入控制对于明确的释义比对于习语对应物显示出更大的粗略类别共享。然而，阅读并不一定意味着有效的擦除：英语适配的LEACE比孟加拉语适配的LEACE擦除的孟加拉语比喻类精度低不到一个百分点（与4-11个百分点的差异相比）；INLP显示出类似的非对称性。模式过滤分析、协方差加权输入映射和二元高斯重叠界限解释了这些操作如何产生分歧。类似的多类排序是一种经验诊断，在12个单元中的11个中观察到。结果支持跨语言概念共享的估计器敏感度解释，并促使分别评估阅读、分类器转移、擦除和重叠。

articles.title: LLM-based Multi-Criteria Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Efficient 5G UPF Selection
articles.abstract: User plane function (UPF) selection in 5G networks is an active area of research, with various limited approaches proposed to enhance network efficiency and manage resources effectively. In this paper, we address this gap in the related literature by proposing a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) UPF selection method that utilizes a dynamic, multi-objective reward function and validating it on a real-world 5G emulation platform. The proposed method is based on the large language models' (LLMs) translation of network operator intents and the network data analytics function (NWDAF) abnormality alerts. The experimental results validated in the real-world experimental setup demonstrate that our dynamic DRL solution achieves an effective balance between latency, power consumption, and traffic distribution, outperforming the heuristic baselines and fixed DRL by 16.89%. These findings highlight the real-world applicability of our approach for dynamic, intent-driven UPF selection.
articles.comment: Accepted at IEEE Globecom 2026 CSM
articles.titleCn: 基于LLM的多标准深度强化学习动态高效5G UPF选择
articles.abstractCn: 5G网络中的用户平面功能（UPF）选择是一个活跃的研究领域，提出了多种有限的方法来提高网络效率和有效管理资源。在本文中，我们通过提出一种利用动态多目标奖励函数的深度强化学习（DRL）UPF选择方法，填补了相关文献中的空白，并在真实的5G仿真平台上验证了该方法。该方法基于大型语言模型（LLM）对网络运营商意图的翻译和网络数据分析功能（NWDAF）异常警报。在真实实验设置中验证的实验结果表明，我们的动态DRL解决方案在延迟、功耗和流量分配之间实现了有效平衡，比启发式基线和固定DRL提高了16.89%。这些发现突出了我们方法在动态、意图驱动UPF选择中的实际应用价值。

articles.title: AOP-Smart-Finder: A High-Throughput Human-AI Hybrid Framework for AOP Discovery and Evidence Mapping from Large-Scale Literature
articles.abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature and the high heterogeneity of biological terminology and mechanistic descriptions make it difficult for researchers to integrate scattered research evidence, identify connections among biological events, and construct mechanistic networks. Here, we developed a high-throughput human-AI hybrid framework, AOP-Smart-Finder, for biological event discovery, relationship mining, and Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP) construction and evidence mapping from large-scale literature. This framework integrates Large Language Models (LLMs), AOP-Smart retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology, and Python-based automation, supporting two analysis modes: one based on a single compound and the other based on a predefined set of biological events. In the di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) case, the system processed 12,983 articles within 30 min and included 1,093 of them, from which it extracted 1,589 biological events (including 458 official key events [KEs] and 1,131 candidate KEs) and 2,519 key event relationships (KERs). In the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) case, the system identified 55 stressors from 437 articles and extracted 278 biological events and 548 event relationships. Following manual curation and Weight of Evidence (WoE) evaluation, a mechanistic network comprising 16 KEs and 23 KERs was ultimately constructed. This framework can either use existing AOPs as knowledge guidance for mechanistic expansion and evidence supplementation, or discover novel event connections and construct mechanistic networks around user-specified research topics. It provides a high-throughput, traceable, human-AI hybrid methodology for complex biological mechanism elucidation and AOP discovery driven by large-scale literature.
articles.titleCn: AOP-Smart-Finder：一种用于从大规模文献中发现AOP并绘制证据的高通量人机混合框架
articles.abstractCn: 科学文献的快速增长以及生物术语和机制描述的高度异质性，使得研究人员难以整合零散的研究证据、识别生物事件之间的联系以及构建机制网络。在此，我们开发了一个高通量人机混合框架AOP-Smart-Finder，用于生物事件发现、关系挖掘和从大规模文献中构建不良结局通路（AOP）及证据映射。该框架整合了大型语言模型（LLM）、AOP-Smart检索增强生成（RAG）技术以及基于Python的自动化，支持两种分析模式：一种基于单一化合物，另一种基于预定义的生物事件集合。在邻苯二甲酸二（2-乙基己基）酯（DEHP）案例中，系统在30分钟内处理了12,983篇文章，并选取了其中的1,093篇，从中提取了1,589个生物事件（包括458个官方关键事件[KE]和1,131个候选KE）以及2,519个关键事件关系（KER）。在肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）案例中，系统从437篇文章中识别出55个应激物，并提取了278个生物事件和548个事件关系。经过人工审核和证据权重（WoE）评估，最终构建了一个包含16个KE和23个KER的机制网络。该框架可以采用现有的AOP作为机制扩展和证据补充的知识指导，也可以发现新的事件联系，围绕用户指定的研究主题构建机制网络。它为复杂生物机制阐明和基于大规模文献的AOP发现提供了一种高通量、可追溯的人机混合方法。

articles.title: Agent Self-Improvement with Frozen Weights: The Added Value and Limits of Failure Traces
articles.abstract: We evaluate whether an AI agent's harness, the notes around its model, can learn from the agent's failure traces beyond a matched search that never sees them. It can, but less than it looks. We tested an open 9-billion-parameter model with fixed weights; a larger teacher model wrote its notes. On generated customer-service decisions, where both note writers were told the target rules, notes based on the agent's mistakes improved accuracy by 4.0 percentage points over notes from the same process with the mistakes withheld. That process alone, trying and keeping better-scoring notes, reached about 60% of the total improvement. In full customer-service conversations the same notes showed no demonstrated improvement. Separately, a strict screen of single lessons admitted two customer-service lessons, still awaiting tests on new data, and one tool-use lesson, written without seeing the agent's mistakes, which showed no demonstrated gain on new tool-use tasks. A neutral note with no procedure scored higher than the learned lessons (exploratory). A blind audit judged 146 of 240 tool-use test items defective.
articles.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Code and data: https://github.com/hopit-ai/harness-mistakes-artifacts
articles.titleCn: 带有冻结权重的智能体自我改进：失败追踪的增值与局限
articles.abstractCn: 我们评估了AI代理的约束机制，即其模型周围的注释，是否能在从未见过这些失败轨迹的匹配搜索之外从代理的失败轨迹中学习。它确实能学习，但效果不如预期。我们测试了一个参数量为90亿的固定权重开放模型；一个更大的教师模型为其编写注释。在生成的客户服务决策中，告知注释编写者目标规则的注释，基于代理错误编写的注释比隐藏错误的相同过程编写的注释准确率提高了4个百分点。仅此过程，通过尝试和保留评分更高的注释，就达到了约60%的总改进。在完整的客户服务对话中，相同的注释并未显示出任何改进。另外，严格的单一课程筛选中包含了两个等待新数据测试的客户服务课程，以及一个未看到代理错误的工具使用课程，该课程在新工具使用任务上并未显示出任何增益。一个没有程序的中立注释（探索性）得分高于学习到的课程。盲审判定240个工具使用测试项中的146项存在缺陷。

articles.title: ReGKG-2025: A GKG-Compatible Reconstruction of the GDELT Global Knowledge Graph for the Missing Period of 14 June to 2 July 2025
articles.abstract: The June 2025 outage in the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) collection pipeline left a gap in the Global Knowledge Graph (GKG), interrupting article-level news metadata used in downstream research. ReGKG-2025 is an archive-derived sample of 281,620 reconstructed article records covering all 1,665 missing 15-minute batches. Articles were recovered from Common Crawl and the Wayback Machine using source quotas estimated from surrounding native GKG data. Text was screened and normalized, non-English bodies were translated, and flagged records were manually reviewed. Eligible articles were converted to the 27-column GKG 2.1 layout. The versioned package includes record-level provenance, archive replay and WARC locators, source summaries, source-by-day calibration weights, and the complete manual decision journal. The sample reaches about 14% of modeled native volume and represents sources accounting for 84% of selected reference record mass. In an intact-week test, 41% of recovered articles matched native GKG records; field agreement on matched pairs is close to the processor baseline (tone MAE 1.69). The dataset supports retrospective content analysis and source-level aggregates; its tone and theme distributions differ from native GKG, and it does not support exhaustive counts. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964265.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables, including appendices. Companion methods paper: arXiv:2610.35358. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964265
articles.titleCn: ReGKG-2025：一个适用于GKG的GDELT全球知识图谱重建，覆盖2025年6月14日至7月2日期间的缺失数据
articles.abstractCn: 2025年6月，全球事件、语言和情绪数据库（GDELT）集合管道的停机导致全球知识图谱（GKG）出现空白，中断了下游研究中使用的文章级新闻元数据。ReGKG-2025是一个基于存档的样本，包含281,620条重建的文章记录，涵盖了全部1,665个缺失的15分钟批次。文章从通用爬取（Common Crawl）和网页存档（Wayback Machine）中恢复，其来源配额是根据周围原生GKG数据估算的。文本经过筛选和标准化，非英文文本被翻译，标记记录经过人工审核。符合条件的文章被转换为27列的GKG 2.1格式。版本化数据包包括记录级别的来源信息、存档重放和WARC定位符、来源摘要、按日校准的来源权重以及完整的决策日志。该样本约占建模原生容量的14%，代表84%的选定参考记录质量。在完整周测试中，41%恢复的文章与原生GKG记录匹配；匹配对的字段一致性接近处理器基线（情绪平均绝对误差1.69）。该数据集支持回顾性内容分析和来源级汇总；其情绪和主题分布与原生GKG不同，且不支持详尽计数。数据：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23964265。

articles.title: ScrapeBench: Evaluating Legal Compliance of AI Agents in Website Scraping
articles.abstract: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. In this paper, we introduce ScrapeBench, the first agentic benchmark for empirically evaluating the legal compliance of AI agents with website scraping policies, namely terms of service (ToS) and robots.txt directives. Across widely used closed-weight and open-weight AI agents, we find that most agents exhibit low compliance rates (< 5%) when instructed to scrape websites in our sample of 1,626 popular websites that explicitly prohibit scraping. In addition, we observe that even where AI agents actively check the applicable ToS and robots.txt, they continue to exhibit low compliance rates. Conversely, in our sample of 269 websites that do not prohibit scraping, we observe that agents sometimes refuse to scrape despite it being lawful, such as Claude Opus 4.6 exhibiting an over-refusal rate of 98.5%. Our human baseline experiments (n = 180 participants) suggest that humans exhibit compliance rates comparable to AI agents but over-refuse at much higher rates.
articles.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
articles.titleCn: ScrapeBench：评估网站抓取中AI代理的法律合规性
articles.abstractCn: 部署在公开网络上的AI代理在执行可能违反合同条款和计算机安全法律的行为方面变得越来越有能力。在本文中，我们介绍了ScrapeBench，这是首个用于通过实证评估AI代理在网站抓取政策（即服务条款和robots.txt指令）方面的法律合规性的代理基准。在广泛使用的封闭权重和开放权重AI代理中，我们发现当被指示抓取我们样本中的1,626个明确禁止抓取的网站时，大多数代理的合规率低于5%。此外，我们观察到即使AI代理会主动检查适用的服务条款和robots.txt，它们的合规率仍然很低。相反，在我们样本中的269个不禁止抓取的网站中，我们观察到代理有时会拒绝抓取，即使这是合法的，例如Claude Opus 4.6的拒绝率高达98.5%。我们的基准人类实验（180名参与者）表明，人类的合规率与AI代理相当，但拒绝率要高得多。

articles.title: EASE-KV: Diagnosing the Gap Between Memory Availability and Effective Use
articles.abstract: Reusable key-value (KV) memory avoids repeatedly prefilling retrieved text, but stored and injected memories do not necessarily become usable evidence. We present EASE-KV, a controlled framework for understanding this gap under fixed candidates and a frozen language model. EASE-KV separates three interfaces: whether required relations are preserved during encoding, whether preserved memories receive appropriate influence during allocation, and whether outcome supervision can identify useful allocations. Matched experiments show that causal encoding improves compositional accuracy by 25.0 percentage points over block-diagonal encoding, while the tested inference-time bridging methods fail to recover the lost contextual information. With unchanged stored states, diagnostic evidence-guided allocation improves LongMemEval accuracy from 31.2% to 38.4%, demonstrating that memory influence can be controlled without re-encoding. However, controllability does not guarantee learnability: binary correctness provides informative reward contrast for 53.0% of sampled query groups, compared with 73.6% under the evaluated shaped-reward setting. These findings show that effective KV memory requires more than retrieval and injection: the required relations must be encoded, preserved memories must receive appropriate influence, and supervision must distinguish better allocations from worse ones.
articles.comment: Preprint
articles.titleCn: EASE-KV：诊断内存可用性与有效利用之间的差距
articles.abstractCn: 可重用键值（KV）内存避免了反复预填充检索到的文本，但存储和注入的内存并不一定成为可用证据。我们提出了EASE-KV，这是一个在固定候选和冻结语言模型下理解这一差距的控制框架。EASE-KV将三个接口分离：编码过程中是否保留了所需关系，保留的内存在分配时是否获得适当影响，以及结果监督是否能识别有用分配。匹配实验表明，因果编码比块对角编码将组合准确性提高了25.0个百分点，而测试的推理时桥接方法未能恢复丢失的上下文信息。在存储状态不变的情况下，诊断证据引导的分配将LongMemEval准确性从31.2%提高到38.4%，证明内存影响可以在不重新编码的情况下控制。然而，可控性并不保证可学习性：二进制正确性在53.0%的采样查询组中提供了信息丰富的奖励对比，而评估的形状奖励设置下为73.6%。这些发现表明，有效的KV内存不仅需要检索和注入：所需关系必须在编码中体现，保留的内存必须获得适当影响，监督必须能区分更好的分配与较差的分配。

articles.title: WarBias: A Bilingual LLM Benchmark of Stereotypes About Internally Displaced People and Veterans
articles.abstract: This paper contains examples of stereotypes about veterans and displaced people that may be offensive or distressing. Social bias benchmarks for language models commonly examine categories such as gender, race, and religion, often drawn from lists of legally protected characteristics. Veterans and internally displaced people (IDPs) fall outside these lists, and stereotypes about them, which can undermine access to employment, housing, and social participation, remain largely absent from language model evaluation. We introduce WarBias, a Ukrainian--English benchmark of stereotypes about these two groups. Built from a taxonomy of 120 stereotype claims grounded in research and monitoring reports, WarBias contains 1,007 stereotype--counter-stereotype--unrelated sentence triplets and 240 multiple-choice questions per language. A Ukrainian language model selected in a blinded human pilot generated the Ukrainian triplets. At least two independent annotators reviewed each triplet in the annotation cohort. The authors revised items in response to the reviews, and the final release was machine-translated into English. Each claim carries a human severity rating. In a baseline evaluation of six models, four prefer stereotypical Ukrainian sentences about at least one group, most strongly about IDPs, while English scores are mostly balanced. WarBias supports complementary evaluations of stereotypical preferences and context-sensitive judgments, and provides paired forget/retain material for unlearning-based bias mitigation. We document the benchmark's construction, intended uses, and limitations, and offer its construction method as a template for analogous benchmarks in other conflict-affected societies.
articles.titleCn: 战争偏见：关于内部流离失所者和退伍军人的双语LLM基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 本文包含可能具有冒犯性或令人痛苦的关于退伍军人和平民流离失所者的刻板印象示例。语言模型的社会偏见基准通常检验性别、种族和宗教等类别，这些类别通常来自受法律保护的特性清单。退伍军人和内部流离失所者（IDP）不属于这些清单，关于他们的刻板印象，这些刻板印象可能破坏就业、住房和社交参与，在很大程度上仍未被语言模型评估所涵盖。我们介绍了WarBias，这是一个关于这两类群体的乌克兰-英语刻板印象基准。该基准基于120个基于研究和监测报告的刻板印象声明分类构建，包含1007个刻板印象-反刻板印象-无关句子三元组和每语言240个多项选择题。乌克兰语言模型在盲法人类试点中生成乌克兰三元组。在标注队列中，每个三元组至少由两名独立标注者进行审查。作者根据审查意见修改了项目，最终版本通过机器翻译成英语。每个声明都带有人类严重程度评分。在六种模型的基线评估中，四种模型偏好至少一个群体的刻板印象乌克兰句子，最强烈针对IDP，而英语得分大多平衡。WarBias支持刻板印象偏好和情境敏感判断的补充评估，并提供成对的遗忘/保留材料用于基于遗忘的偏见缓解。我们记录了基准的构建、预期用途和局限性，并将其构建方法作为其他受冲突影响社会类似基准的模板。

articles.title: Task-adaptive anonymisation enables privacy-preserving sharing of clinical speech data
articles.abstract: Clinical speech is increasingly used for disease screening and clinical assessment, but directly distributing speech recordings poses privacy risks because they contain both speaker-identifying voiceprints and sensitive spoken content. Existing speech anonymisation approaches are primarily developed for general speech applications or task-specific clinical speech and overlook that different clinical tasks rely on distinct speech characteristics, necessitating task-adaptive anonymisation strategies to protect patient privacy while preserving clinical utility. Here we introduce CASA, a clinically adaptive speech anonymisation agent that transforms anonymisation from a fixed processing procedure into a task-guided optimisation process, dynamically tailoring voiceprint and content anonymisation to task-specific privacy and clinical utility requirements. Through recursive self-improvement (RSI), CASA iteratively evaluates and refines anonymisation strategies against task-specific privacy and clinical utility requirements, while learning from these outcomes to guide more efficient planning in subsequent clinical tasks. CASA is validated across 14 clinical tasks encompassing five languages, diverse elicitation paradigms, and mental health, cognitive and voice disorders. CASA preserved disease-related classification performance while meeting speaker-anonymisation requirements across all clinical tasks, versus only 8/14 for the strongest fixed method. Assessments of resistance to speaker re-identification by external attackers and identification and redaction of sensitive personal information in clinical speech further demonstrated CASA's dual protection of speaker identity and sensitive spoken content. Clinical expert assessments further supported the preservation of clinically relevant information and the acceptability of anonymised speech for controlled research sharing.
articles.titleCn: 任务自适应匿名化技术能够实现临床语音数据的隐私保护共享
articles.abstractCn: 临床语音越来越多地用于疾病筛查和临床评估，但直接分发语音录音存在隐私风险，因为它们既包含说话人识别的声纹，也包含敏感的语音内容。现有的语音匿名化方法主要针对通用语音应用或特定任务的临床语音开发，而忽略了不同临床任务依赖于不同的语音特征，需要任务自适应的匿名化策略来保护患者隐私，同时保留临床效用。在此，我们介绍了CASA，一个临床自适应语音匿名化代理，它将匿名化从固定的处理流程转变为任务引导的优化过程，动态调整声纹和内容匿名化以适应特定任务的隐私和临床效用需求。通过递归自改进（RSI），CASA迭代评估和优化匿名化策略，以满足特定任务的隐私和临床效用要求，同时从这些结果中学习，以指导后续临床任务更高效的规划。CASA在涵盖五种语言、多样化的诱导范式以及心理健康、认知和语音障碍的14项临床任务中进行了验证。CASA在所有临床任务中均满足说话人匿名化要求的同时，保留了与疾病相关的分类性能，而最强的固定方法仅在8/14的任务中达到这一效果。对外部攻击者进行说话人重新识别的抵抗性评估，以及在临床语音中识别和编辑敏感个人信息，进一步证明了CASA对说话人身份和敏感语音内容的双重保护。临床专家评估进一步支持了临床相关信息得以保留，以及匿名化语音在受控研究共享中的可接受性。

articles.title: Understanding When and Where Self-Supervised Speech Models Learn Phonemes and Prosodic Cues through Layer-Wise and Time-Resolved Probing
articles.abstract: Self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) encode a rich hierarchy of acoustic, prosodic, and phonetic information, yet when and where it emerges during pretraining remains unclear. We train frozen-encoder probes on every Transformer layer across pretraining checkpoints of two matched models: HuBERT-Base, whose stage 2 is a separately initialized model trained on new pseudo-label targets, and single-objective wav2vec 2.0-Base. Our five tasks span an acoustic-to-abstract gradient: absolute pitch (F0), speaker-relative pitch, lexical stress, phoneme boundaries, and 38-way phoneme identity. Acoustic-prosodic cues and phone boundaries are decodable from the earliest checkpoints and barely shift across layers, whereas phoneme identity is constructed during pretraining, re-localizing to upper-middle layers under HuBERT's stage-2 targets at a matched update count. Acquisition order therefore tracks abstraction from the acoustic surface, not the segmental/suprasegmental distinction, extending to prosody an account established for phonetic, lexical and syntactic structure; the no-switch wav2vec 2.0 shows no comparable re-localization.
articles.titleCn: 理解自监督语音模型何时以及何地通过逐层和时间解析探测学习音素和韵律线索
articles.abstractCn: 自监督语音模型（S3Ms）编码了丰富的声学、韵律和音位信息层次结构，但其预训练过程中何时以及何地出现这些信息尚不明确。我们在两个匹配模型的预训练检查点中的每一层Transformer层上训练冻结编码器探针：HuBERT-Base（其阶段2是一个单独初始化的模型，在新伪标签目标上训练）和单目标wav2vec 2.0-Base。我们的五个任务涵盖了从声学到抽象的梯度：绝对音高（F0）、相对音高、词汇重音、音位边界和38种音位身份。声学-韵律线索和音位边界最早出现在检查点中，且几乎不随层变化，而音位身份是在预训练过程中构建的，在HuBERT的阶段2目标下，在匹配的更新次数时重新定位到上层中间层。因此，获取顺序跟踪了从声学表面到抽象的过程，而非音节/超音节区分，将已为音位、词汇和句法结构建立的解释扩展到了韵律；而wav2vec 2.0的无切换版本则未显示出类似的重定位现象。

articles.title: Saidzoda-Tajik-EmbeddingGemma-300M: Knowing Every Letter Is Not Reading Tajik
articles.abstract: EmbeddingGemma-300M is a small open embedder whose tokenizer represents every Tajik letter, and as released it is weak at Tajik retrieval: on our Tajik law test the right passage is in its top ten results for 49.3% of questions, on tax documents for 45.9%, and on the human-written Belebele Tajik set for 69.8%, against 98.6% on the Russian version of the same set. We present Saidzoda-Tajik-EmbeddingGemma-300M, the same model fully fine-tuned for one epoch on 235,140 question and passage pairs written by our own Tajik language model for laws, tax documents, Wikipedia and web text, with the same mined hard negatives, English and Russian replay, loss, global batch, learning rate and epoch as our earlier Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large (arXiv:2611.00592) and BGE-M3 models. After training, law reaches 92.4% and tax 91.7%; on Belebele, the one test written by people, recall@10 rises from 69.8% to 92.6% and the first result is right for 76.6% of questions instead of 51.7%. A checkpoint at step 100 of 466 already holds 88% of the law gain at recall@10. At recall@10 the result is no more than 2.8 points below the two 560M models trained on the same pairs on law, tax and Wikipedia, within the intervals, with 768-dimensional vectors and about half their parameters; at recall@1, for which we have no intervals, it stays 7.0 points behind the E5 model on Belebele. The cost is a drop of 3.0 and 2.8 points in Russian and English recall@1, larger than for the two earlier models. We also report that, according to our run notes, a bfloat16 test run produced a non-finite loss at step 3 which the training framework logged as zero, so training was done in fp32. Our generated test questions come from the same model as the training questions, so we treat those scores as an upper limit until questions written by Tajik speakers exist.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 4 tables, 1 figure. Technical report. Model: https://huggingface.co/Tohirju/Saidzoda-Tajik-EmbeddingGemma-300M
articles.titleCn: 赛德佐达-塔吉克-嵌入Gemma-300M：认识每个字母并不等于阅读塔吉克语
articles.abstractCn: EmbeddingGemma-300M 是一个小型开源嵌入器，其分词器表示每个塔吉克字母，并且在其发布版本中，塔吉克检索能力较弱：在我们的塔吉克法律测试中，正确段落出现在其前十个结果中的比例为49.3%，在税务文件中为45.9%，在人类编写的Belebele塔吉克数据集中为69.8%，而同一数据集的俄语版本则为98.6%。我们提出了Saidzoda-Tajik-EmbeddingGemma-300M，该模型在235,140对由我们自己的塔吉克语言模型编写的法律、税务文件、维基百科和网页文本问题上进行了一个epoch的完全微调，与我们的早期Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large（arXiv:2611.00592）和BGE-M3模型使用相同的挖掘的困难负样本、英语和俄语回复、损失、全局批处理、学习率和epoch。训练后，法律达到92.4%，税务达到91.7%；在Belebele（人类编写的一个测试集）上，recall@10从69.8%提升到92.6%，正确答案出现在76.6%的问题中，而不是51.7%。在步骤100（共466步）的一个检查点已经达到了法律recall@10增益的88%。在recall@10上，结果不超过两个在相同对上训练的560M模型的2.8分差距，这些模型在法律、税务和维基百科上训练，具有768维向量，参数量大约是它们的一半；在recall@1上（我们没有区间），它仍然落后于Belebele上的E5模型7.0分。代价是俄语和英语recall@1分别下降了3.0和2.8分，比之前的两个模型更大。我们还报告，根据我们的运行记录，一次bfloat16测试运行在步骤3产生了非有限损失，训练框架将其记录为零，因此训练是在fp32下进行的。我们的生成测试问题来自与训练问题相同的模型，因此我们将这些分数视为上限，直到存在由塔吉克人编写的问题。

articles.title: A Layer-wise Study of How Style Rewriting Breaks the Calibration of Zero-Shot LLM Fake-News Detectors
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked to judge whether a news article is true, and their stated confidence is often taken at face value. We test what happens to that confidence when an article's writing style, but not its facts, is manipulated, as in recent \emph{style attacks} on fake-news detectors. Tracing how the prediction and its confidence form layer by layer inside the network, we study three model families (LLaMA-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) on three fake-news benchmarks, and find the same three patterns in every model--dataset pairing. First, on the original articles the models are competent and largely honest judges: they settle on an answer, briefly become overconfident, and then correct their confidence in the final layers. Second, style-rewritten articles break this self-correction: the models become far less accurate, under the strongest attack, worse than random guessing, yet remain just as confident, so they are \emph{confidently wrong} precisely when a warning is most needed. Third, nearly all of the damage comes from rewriting into sensational or emotionally charged styles, while sober, neutral rewrites leave the models' honesty largely intact. The practical implication is that an LLM's confidence about veracity cannot be trusted as a safety signal when an article's style may have been manipulated.
articles.titleCn: 一种关于风格重写如何破坏零样本LLM假新闻检测器校准的逐层研究
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被要求判断新闻文章的真伪，并且人们往往直接采信其声称的置信度。我们测试了当文章的写作风格而非事实被操纵时（例如近期针对假新闻检测器的风格攻击），其置信度会发生什么。通过追踪预测及其置信度在网络内部逐层形成的过程，我们在三个假新闻基准测试上研究了三种模型家族（LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B），并在每个模型-数据集组合中发现了相同的三个模式。首先，在原始文章上，模型表现合格且大体诚实：它们会确定一个答案，短暂变得过度自信，然后在最终层修正其置信度。其次，风格改写的文章破坏了这种自我修正：在最强攻击下，模型的准确度大幅下降，甚至不如随机猜测，但其置信度依然如故，因此它们在最需要警示时恰恰表现得“自信错误”。第三，几乎所有损害都源于改写成煽情或情绪化的风格，而冷静、中性的改写则大体保留了模型的诚实性。实际意义在于，当文章的风格可能被操纵时，不能将LLM对真实性的置信度视为安全信号。

articles.title: TLRS-DPO: Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization
articles.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a simple and widely used alternative to RLHF for aligning large language models (LLMs), but its sequence-level objective cannot precisely locate or suppress the local patterns that make an otherwise acceptable response unsafe or undesirable. We propose TLRS-DPO (Token-Level Risk Scoring for Better Direct Preference Optimization), which augments DPO with fine-grained token-level control while remaining fully offline and reference-based. TLRS-DPO introduces a token-level robust compensation term that converts the policy-reference log-ratio on rejected responses into localized risk scores, a curriculum-style schedule that gradually increases the strength of this compensation during training, and a risk-adaptive screening mechanism that selectively penalizes only high-risk tokens instead of entire sequences. This design bridges sequence-level preference fitting and token-level behavior control, and can be implemented as a drop-in modification to standard DPO trainers. Empirically, TLRS-DPO improves alignment quality and safety-relevant behavior with minimal impact on helpfulness compared to strong DPO baselines.
articles.titleCn: TLRS-DPO：基于token级别的风险评分优化直接偏好优化
articles.abstractCn: 直接偏好优化（DPO）是一种简单且广泛使用的替代方案，用于通过强化学习人类反馈（RLHF）来对齐大型语言模型（LLMs），但其序列级目标无法精确定位或抑制导致原本可接受回复变得不安全或不理想的地方。我们提出了TLRS-DPO（更优直接偏好优化的标记级风险评分），它在不脱离完全离线和基于参考的前提下，为DPO增加了细粒度的标记级控制。TLRS-DPO引入了一个标记级鲁棒补偿项，将拒绝回复上的策略-参考对数比转换为局部风险评分，一个逐步增强补偿强度训练过程中的课程式调度，以及一个风险自适应筛选机制，该机制仅选择性地惩罚高风险标记而不是整个序列。这种设计连接了序列级偏好拟合和标记级行为控制，并且可以作为标准DPO训练器的即插即用修改来实现。实证结果表明，与强大的DPO基线相比，TLRS-DPO在提高对齐质量和安全相关行为的同时，对有用性影响最小。

articles.title: SGA-Sparse: Training Native SwiGLU Gates for Activation-Sparse and Low-Bit LLMs
articles.abstract: Activation sparsity can reduce FFN weight traffic during single-user LLM decoding, but active channels must be identified early enough to avoid fetching unused weights. In pretrained SwiGLU models, training-free routing with the native gate performs substantially worse than routing with the up activation at high sparsity. We show that this ordering reverses after sparsity-aware training. Based on this insight, we introduce SGA-Sparse, which converts pretrained SwiGLU LLMs into fixed-budget activation-sparse models by training the existing gate projection directly as a top-k router. SGA-Sparse updates all model parameters end-to-end while preserving the original SwiGLU activation and introducing no auxiliary router parameters. After approximately 30B training tokens, LLaMA models from 1B to 8B achieve uniform per-token 75-85% FFN channel sparsity while remaining within 0.2-2.7 pp of their original dense checkpoints in average zero-shot accuracy. Because post-training quantization degrades sparsity-trained checkpoints, we further study two complementary quantization-aware training (QAT) recipes: continued-QAT largely recovers performance at 4-bit weight quantization, while joint-QAT performs better for the more aggressive sub-4-bit target. To compare activation sparsity with dense low-bit quantization, we translate the sparsity-induced reduction in weight traffic into an equivalent bit-width. Under this unified weight-traffic metric, our 2.5- and 1.5-bit-equivalent models establish a new accuracy-traffic Pareto frontier: the 2.5-bit-equivalent models match dense 3-bit QAT accuracy, while the 1.5-bit-equivalent models approach dense 2-bit models and outperform dense ternary models by 1.3 pp on average. These results establish native-gate training as a practical approach for combining high FFN sparsity with low-bit weights.
articles.titleCn: SGA-Sparse：为激活稀疏和低比特LLM训练原生SwiGLU门
articles.abstractCn: 激活稀疏性可以在单用户LLM解码过程中减少FFN权重流量，但必须尽早识别活跃通道以避免获取未使用的权重。在预训练的SwiGLU模型中，使用原生门进行无训练路由在高稀疏度下表现远差于使用上激活的路由。我们证明，经过稀疏感知训练后，这种顺序会反转。基于这一见解，我们引入了SGA-Sparse，它通过将现有的门投影直接训练为top-k路由器，将预训练的SwiGLU LLM转换为固定预算的激活稀疏模型。SGA-Sparse在保留原始SwiGLU激活的同时，端到端更新所有模型参数，且不引入任何辅助路由器参数。经过大约30B训练token后，1B到8B的LLaMA模型实现了均匀的每token75-85%的FFN通道稀疏度，同时平均零样本准确率保持在原始密集检查点的0.2-2.7 pp范围内。由于后训练量化会降低稀疏训练检查点的稀疏性，我们进一步研究了两种互补的量化感知训练（QAT）配方：持续QAT在4位权重量化下基本恢复性能，而联合QAT对于更激进的亚4位目标表现更优。为了比较激活稀疏性与密集低比特量化，我们将稀疏性引起的权重流量减少转化为等效比特宽度。在这个统一的权重流量指标下，我们的2.5位和1.5位等效模型建立了新的准确率-流量帕累托前沿：2.5位等效模型匹配了密集3位QAT的准确率，而1.5位等效模型接近密集2位模型，并在平均上比密集三元模型高1.3 pp。这些结果将原生门训练确立为结合高FFN稀疏性与低比特权重的实用方法。

articles.title: Deterministic Narrative Gravity: Bridging Theory of Mind and Historical Simulation through ABM-LLM Architectures
articles.abstract: Historical social simulation faces a fundamental reproducibility challenge: the stochastic nature of large language models (LLMs) introduces a digital butterfly effect that prevents exact replication across multi-turn runs. Furthermore, the inability to control low-level server parameters in commercial LLM hosting environments severely limits reproducibility. To overcome this opacity, we present a deterministic multi-agent framework coupling LLMs to an Agent-Based Modelling (ABM) pipeline grounded in Theory of Mind (ToM) and Cognitive Archaeology, and validate exact artifact identity within local, pinned execution environments using SHA-256 hashing. Run locally at temperature zero with clean per-call model reloads, the system injects differentiated cognitive states per turn through dissonance-driven behavioural modes and gated internal voices. Evaluating seven model configurations spanning 4B to 31B parameters against an ablated baseline reveals clear operational boundaries. Small models ($\leq$8B) suffer from context capacity overload, producing repetitive, specular dialogue loops. However, at $\geq$12B parameters, the ABM scaffolding breaks the monotonous response patterns seen in ablation. Crucially, these scaffolded models exhibit spontaneous diegetic expansion: they coherently expand scenario lore through tactically motivated, anachronism-free details rather than escalating into aggression. By resisting the structural pull toward premature scene closure, scaffolded sessions sustain an open terminal Narrative Vector ($V_N = \mathrm{Open}$ in 12/21 overall; 9/9 in official $\geq$12B configurations) whereas unscaffolded ablation never does (0/21). This framework provides a transparent, auditable benchmark architecture for virtual archaeology, with the full pipeline released as open-source software to enable independent replication.
articles.comment: 28 pages, 2 figures. To appear in the Journal of Computer Applications in Archaeology. Code: https://github.com/alixiacf/cognitive-abm
articles.titleCn: 确定性叙事重力：通过ABM-LLM架构连接心智理论历史模拟
articles.abstractCn: 历史社会模拟面临一个根本性的可复现性挑战：大型语言模型（LLM）的随机性引入了数字蝴蝶效应，导致跨多轮运行无法精确复制。此外，在商业LLM托管环境中无法控制底层服务器参数，严重限制了可复现性。为克服这种不透明性，我们提出了一种确定性多智能体框架，将LLM与基于心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）和认知考古学的基于智能体建模（Agent-Based Modelling, ABM）流程相结合，并使用SHA-256哈希算法在本地固定执行环境中验证精确的文物身份。在温度零下本地运行，并使用干净的每次调用模型重载，该系统通过驱动力不一致的行为模式和受控内部声音，每轮注入差异化的认知状态。评估涵盖4B到31B参数范围的七种模型配置与消融基线，揭示了明显的操作边界。小型模型（≤8B）因上下文容量超载而出现问题，产生重复的镜像式对话循环。然而，在≥12B参数时，ABM框架打破了消融中看到的单调响应模式。关键在于，这些框架化模型表现出自发的叙事性扩展：它们通过具有战术动机且无时代错乱的细节，连贯地扩展场景背景，而不是升级为攻击性。通过抵制过早场景闭合的结构性拉力，框架化会话维持了开放终端叙事向量（在总体21次中12次为开放；在官方≥12B配置中9/9次为开放），而未框架化的消融从未做到（0/21）。该框架为虚拟考古学提供了一个透明、可审计的基准架构，完整流程已作为开源软件发布，以支持独立复制。

articles.title: Dhara: Evidence-Oriented Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems
articles.abstract: Relevant evidence in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS) collections may be distributed across passages in different parts of a work, including verses, translations, and commentaries. Locating it requires matching natural-language questions and partially remembered verse fragments to source passages. We present Dhara, a retrieval engine combining hybrid search, chapter- and book-level Entity Notes (EN), Fuzzy Verse Retrieval (FVR), and neural reranking. Five comparisons on the 325 questions in Dhara Bench examine retrieval representations against BM25, EN's contribution, reranker quality and computation time, FVR, and Gemini. BGE-M3 single-vector retrieval exceeds BM25 in nDCG@10, Recall@20, and MRR@20 across all categories. Its scores are broadly comparable to ColBERTv2, with mean retrieval times of 0.108 s and 0.962 s under the same hardware configuration and a smaller memory footprint for chunk storage on disk. Adding EN to a direct branch with a matched candidate count improves nDCG@10 in all twelve categories with Qwen and ten with BGE; the combined ranking is capped at the same candidate count. Qwen improves nDCG@10, Precision@5, and MRR@20 over BGE in every category, at approximately 6.72 times the overall estimated serial computation time. FVR increases Verse-category nDCG@10 by approximately 20 percentage points with either reranker. Gemini is evaluated after source mapping and manual review with relevance annotations visible. The Qwen pipeline with EN and FVR has higher Recall@20 than Gemini in ten categories and stronger complete-evidence retrieval in Multi-hop questions, while Gemini retains early-relevance advantages in several categories. The results inform retrieval choices according to evidence requirements and resource budgets.

articles.titleCn: Dhara：面向印度知识体系的证据导向检索
articles.abstractCn: 印度知识体系（IKS）文献中的相关证据可能分散在作品不同部分的段落中，包括诗歌、翻译和注释。定位这些证据需要将自然语言问题和部分记忆的诗歌片段与源段落进行匹配。我们提出了Dhara，一个结合混合搜索、章节和书籍级别的实体注释（EN）、模糊诗歌检索（FVR）和神经重新排序的检索引擎。在Dhara基准的5个比较中，针对325个问题，检验了检索表示与BM25、EN的贡献、重新排序器质量与计算时间、FVR和Gemini的对比。BGE-M3单向量检索在所有类别中nDCG@10、Recall@20和MRR@20均优于BM25。其得分与ColBERTv2大致相当，在相同硬件配置下，平均检索时间为0.108秒和0.962秒，且磁盘上存储块占用的内存更小。将EN添加到匹配候选数相同的直接分支上，在12个类别中（Qwen）和10个类别中（BGE）均提高了nDCG@10；组合排序受限于相同的候选数。Qwen在所有类别中均优于BGE，提高了nDCG@10、Precision@5和MRR@20，整体估计串行计算时间约为6.72倍。FVR在两种重新排序器下使诗歌类别nDCG@10提高了约20个百分点。Gemini在源映射和人工审核后进行评估，相关标注可见。Qwen管道结合EN和FVR在10个类别中Recall@20高于Gemini，在多跳问题中具有更强的完整证据检索能力，而Gemini在几个类别中仍保持早期相关优势。这些结果根据证据需求和资源预算为检索选择提供参考。

articles.title: When Are Nearby Experts Composable? Cross-Task Model Merging in Neural Thickets
articles.abstract: Random perturbations around a shared checkpoint can produce experts for distinct tasks, but shared origin does not ensure that their gains survive composition. We formulate expert-pair selection for joint base-relative retention, measured by strict joint success and worst-task gain with unconditional abstention accounting. An exact finite-difference decomposition and an arbitrarily small orthogonal counterexample show why proximity and orthogonality alone are insufficient. We instantiate this formulation with quality-constrained spectral selection, a fixed-budget framework combining cross-task screening, layerwise pair geometry, separate validation, and Base fallback. Across six checkpoints, 21 task pairs, and five independent perturbation pools, the procedure improves strict joint success over Top-1 averaging throughout and leads the four-method model-scale comparison on four of six checkpoints. For the five models with at least 1.5B parameters, matched quality-only, global-cosine, and spectral ranking attain 49.1%, 50.5%, and 53.1% joint success. Under this matched protocol, the spectral selector also yields the highest worst-task gain and Weak Pareto rate and the lowest regression rate. Mean worst-task gain reaches +0.61 percentage points, while 17.1% regression and 13.0% abstention show that composability remains conditional. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/.
articles.titleCn: 当邻近专家可组合时：神经丛中的跨任务模型合并
articles.abstractCn: 在共享检查点周围的随机扰动可以产生用于不同任务的专家，但共享起源并不能保证它们的收益在组合中得以保留。我们提出了专家对选择方法，用于联合基准相对保留度，通过严格联合成功率和最差任务收益（考虑无条件弃权）进行衡量。一个精确的有限差分分解和一个任意小的正交反例表明，仅靠邻近性和正交性是不够的。我们使用质量约束频谱选择方法实例化这一公式，这是一个固定预算框架，结合了跨任务筛选、逐层对几何、单独验证和基准回退。在六个检查点、21对任务和五个独立扰动池中，该程序在整个过程中提高了严格联合成功率，并在六个检查点中的四个上领先于四种方法的模型规模比较。对于至少有1.5B参数的五个模型，匹配质量仅、全局余弦和频谱排序分别达到了49.1%、50.5%和53.1%的联合成功率。在此匹配协议下，频谱选择器还获得了最高最差任务收益和弱帕累托率，以及最低回归率。平均最差任务收益达到+0.61个百分点，而17.1%的回归和13.0%的弃权表明组合性仍然是条件性的。项目页面：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Thickets-Merge/。

articles.title: What Changed in Engineering Writing After Generative AI Chat Assistants: Evidence from 1.8 Million Articles
articles.abstract: This study asks what changed in engineering articles after conversational language models became publicly available on November 30, 2022, and develops methods for measuring such change in a field without a uniform abstract index. It assembled 1,839,962 articles published from 2015 to 2025 in 256 engineering journals, tracked twelve measures of wording, style, and article structure, and compared each with the projection of its own pre-2023 trend. Building the monthly series showed that records dated only by year fall on January 1 and create false January peaks unless removed. In abstracts, 31 words associated with language model output appeared 82% more often than projected (55.4 against 27.0 per 10,000 words in 2025), while four control words of the same formal register fell 16%. Words that soften a claim, such as may, fell 13%, words that strengthen one, such as clearly, rose 20%, and long words rose 11%. Author counts, reference lists, page counts, and publication volume stayed within 4% of trend. The change appears in all fourteen subject categories, and false release dates, dropping any one journal or word, and word lists chosen from the data support it. A random sample of 12,866 full texts from the same corpus, including subscription articles and weighted back to it, shows the same words rising 99% in article bodies. Statements disclosing AI writing assistance, measured apart from mentions of language models, went from none to 3.7% in 2025, four in five of them at one publisher. The design is descriptive, not causal.

articles.titleCn: 生成式AI聊天助手出现后，工程写作发生了哪些变化：基于180万篇文章的证据
articles.abstractCn: 这项研究探讨了在对话式语言模型于2022年11月30日公开后，工程类文章发生了哪些变化，并开发了一种在缺乏统一摘要索引的领域内衡量此类变化的方法。研究收集了2015年至2025年间在256种工程期刊上发表的1,839,962篇文章，追踪了十二项与措辞、风格和文章结构相关的指标，并将每个指标与其2023年前的趋势预测进行了比较。构建的月度系列显示，仅按年份标注的记录落在1月1日，若不剔除，将产生虚假的1月峰值。在摘要中，与语言模型输出相关的31个词出现频率比预测高出82%（2025年每万字出现55.4次，而预测为27.0次），而同正式语体的四个控制词出现频率下降了16%。软化论断的词（如may）出现频率下降13%，强化论断的词（如clearly）上升20%，长词出现频率上升11%。作者数量、参考文献列表、页数和发表量均保持在趋势的4%以内。这种变化出现在所有十四个学科类别中，剔除任何一个期刊或词、以及从数据中选择的词列表都支持这一发现。从同一语料库中随机抽取的12,866篇全文（包括订阅文章并加权回溯），显示文章主体中相同词的出现频率同样上升了99%。披露AI写作辅助的声明（与提及语言模型无关）从无到2025年占比3.7%，其中五分之四来自同一出版商。该研究设计为描述性而非因果性。

articles.title: Do Benign-Trained Hidden-State Probes Detect Tool Errors Under Adversarial Conditions?
articles.abstract: Although hidden-state probes efficiently monitor model operation, it remains unclear whether probes trained on benign tool use remain useful for detecting incorrect actions under adversarial conditions. In this research, we assess this problem from the perspective of operational tool-action correct- ness. we use four AgentDojo suites, four conditions, and three models: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, and GLM- 4.6V-Flash (9B). We perform a five-fold, task-grouped out-of-fold (OOF) evaluation for each model. We train step-specific logistic- regression probes only on benign and non-defended trajectories and evaluate them on held-out trajectories for benign, prompt- injection, system-override, and tool-poisoning conditions. We compare our hidden-state probe to mean tool-call-token entropy, negative mean tool-call-token log-probability, and self-consistency uncertainty. The paired tests highlight six significant differences after Holm correction. All of the tests involve Qwen2.5-14B- Instruct under the system-override condition, with all three scalar uncertainty metrics obtaining higher area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and average precision (AP) than the hidden-state probe. These results suggest that benign-trained hidden-state probes should not be assumed to reliably detect operational tool-action errors under adversarial conditions.
articles.titleCn: 良性训练的隐藏状态探针在对抗条件下能否检测工具错误？
articles.abstractCn: 尽管隐藏状态探针能够高效地监控模型运行，但目前尚不清楚在对抗条件下，仅针对良性工具使用进行训练的探针是否仍然适用于检测错误操作。在本研究中，我们从操作工具-动作正确性的角度评估了这一问题。我们使用了四个AgentDojo套件、四种条件以及三种模型：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct和GLM-4.6V-Flash（9B）。我们对每个模型进行了五折、按任务分组的外折（OOF）评估。我们仅使用良性且未被防御的轨迹训练特定步骤的逻辑回归探针，并在良性、提示注入、系统覆盖和工具中毒条件下对保留的轨迹进行评估。我们将我们的隐藏状态探针与工具调用标记熵均值、负工具调用标记对数概率均值以及自洽不确定性进行了比较。配对测试在Holm校正后突出了六项显著差异。所有测试均涉及Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct在系统覆盖条件下的表现，其中所有三种标量不确定性指标均获得了高于隐藏状态探针的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和平均精度（AP）。这些结果表明，在对抗条件下不应假设良性训练的隐藏状态探针能够可靠地检测操作工具-动作错误。

articles.title: LongCap: Hour-Scale Timestamped Audio Captioning via Chunk-wise Processing
articles.abstract: Describing hours of audio requires accurate event timing and sustained descriptive detail throughout the recording. We present LongCap, a framework for timestamped audio captioning (TAC), with the human-annotated LongCapBench and three diarization-inspired metrics: Timeline Error Rate (TER), Granularity Error Rate (GER), and Caption Similarity (tcpCapSim). LongCap interleaves audio chunks with structured event captions, using relative timestamps and retained context to support length extrapolation within a 1M-token inference context window. Event-level reannotation restores caption detail, while systematic studies examine model scaling, dependency supervision, and self-distillation. LongCap-Diar achieves strong benchmark results and extrapolates to 16 hours of concatenated audio despite training on recordings no longer than 40 minutes. Our TAC models are competitive with Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus on short clips, outperform evaluated baselines in caption similarity and timeline accuracy in segment-level comparisons on LongCapBench-TAC-Long, and caption full recordings approaching two hours. On LongCapBench-TAC, 9B and 35B-A3B offer favorable size-performance tradeoffs, while 122B-A10B substantially improves event-dependency recovery. These findings support long-horizon general audio understanding and provide a foundation for always-on voice agents.
