articles.titleCn: 长时音频描述：基于分块处理的时序音频描述
articles.abstractCn: 描述数小时的音频需要精确的事件时间标注和在整个录音过程中保持持续的描述性细节。我们提出了LongCap，一个用于带时间戳音频字幕（TAC）的框架，以及人工标注的LongCapBench和三个受说话人分割启发的指标：时间线错误率（TER）、粒度错误率（GER）和字幕相似度（tcpCapSim）。LongCap将音频片段与结构化的事件字幕交错，使用相对时间戳和保留的上下文来支持在1M-token推理上下文窗口内的长度外推。事件级别的重新标注恢复了字幕细节，而系统性的研究考察了模型扩展、依赖监督和自蒸馏。LongCap-Diar取得了优异的基准测试结果，并在仅使用40分钟录音进行训练的情况下，能够外推到16小时连续音频。我们的TAC模型在短片段上与Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus具有竞争力，在LongCapBench-TAC-Long的片段级比较中，在字幕相似度和时间线准确性方面优于评估基线，并能够字幕接近两小时的完整录音。在LongCapBench-TAC上，9B和35B-A3B提供了有利的规模-性能权衡，而122B-A10B显著提高了事件依赖恢复能力。这些发现支持长时程的通用音频理解，并为始终在线语音助手奠定了基础。

articles.title: Beyond Hard Labels: LLM Probabilities Improve Human-Assisted Regression
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for text annotation, but their outputs are often reduced to a single categorical label before downstream analysis. This hardening step discards the model's relative support across categories, which may contain useful information when category boundaries are ambiguous. We study whether retaining the full probability vector improves downstream regression when LLM annotations are combined with a limited amount of human annotation. Using matched soft and hard representations from three LLMs across three social-science text datasets, we compare direct regression and human-assisted correction. Soft inputs are not uniformly better when used directly as outcomes, but after human correction, using the probability vector consistently improves regression efficiency across models and datasets. Analyses of repeated human judgments and controlled simulations further show that these gains arise when probability variation beyond the hard category carries useful information about the human-coded outcome. Our results identify output representation as an important design choice in LLM-assisted measurement and support preserving probability outputs for downstream statistical analysis. Code and reproducibility materials are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/soft-label-LLM-D201/

articles.titleCn: 超越硬标签：LLM 概率提升人类辅助回归
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于文本标注，但在下游分析之前，它们的输出通常被简化为单一分类标签。这一硬化步骤会丢弃模型在各个类别中的相对支持度，而在类别边界模糊时，这些支持度可能包含有用信息。我们研究了在LLM标注与有限的人类标注相结合时，保留完整概率向量是否能够改善下游回归。我们使用来自三个LLMs在三个社会科学文本数据集上的匹配软硬表示，比较了直接回归和人类辅助校正。软输入在直接用作结果时并不总是更好，但在经过人类校正后，使用概率向量能够在所有模型和数据集上持续提高回归效率。对重复人类判断和受控模拟的分析进一步表明，这些收益源于超出硬类别的概率变化携带了关于人类编码结果的有用信息。我们的结果表明，输出表示是LLM辅助测量中的一个重要设计选择，并支持保留概率输出以供下游统计分析使用。代码和可复现性材料可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/soft-label-LLM-D201/获取。

articles.title: Task presentation and execution paths shape LLM mathematical performance
articles.abstract: Mathematical performance depends on how a language model receives information, uses generated text and submits an answer. We study these dependencies through paired comparisons that separate submission requirements, draft reuse and candidate availability. On 65 development problems, an instruction permitting continued derivation produced no valid final answers in 390 short-output calls; a single-line submission instruction produced 390 format-valid outputs, including 389 parseable answers. Under the fixed submission protocol, 198 problems with failed initial submissions were answered correctly in 9.09p of cases with the question alone, 33.84p with its draft, 46.46p with candidates, and 59.60p with both. Drafts added 13.13 percentage points with candidates fixed, and candidates added 25.76 points with drafts fixed; both effects were significant after Holm correction and were subadditive on the accuracy scale. Retaining a trailing excerpt outperformed retaining a leading excerpt of similar average length by 10.10 points Holm-adjusted p 0.027. A second completion model showed the same directions of input effects on the fixed materials. In a cohort with parseable initial submissions, candidates added no correct answers when the previous draft was supplied, but added 27 points when it was absent. These results establish a conditional value of generated text: a failed submission can leave useful material, whose contribution depends on what else is supplied and what is retained.
articles.titleCn: 任务呈现和执行路径影响大语言模型数学性能
articles.abstractCn: 数学表现取决于语言模型如何接收信息、使用生成文本并提交答案。我们通过分离提交要求、草稿重用和候选可用性的配对比较来研究这些依赖关系。在65个开发问题上，允许继续推导的指令在390次短输出调用中未产生有效最终答案；单行提交指令产生了390个格式有效的输出，其中包括389个可解析答案。在固定的提交协议下，198个初始提交失败的题目在仅使用问题时正确回答的比例为9.09%，使用草稿时为33.84%，使用候选时为46.46%，使用两者时为59.60%。当候选固定时，草稿增加了13.13个百分点，当草稿固定时，候选增加了25.76个百分点；这两种效应在Holm校正后均显著，并且在准确度尺度上具有次可加性。保留尾部摘录的表现优于保留类似平均长度的头部摘录，Holm校正后的p值为0.027，提高了10.10个百分点。第二个完成模型在固定材料上显示出相同的输入效应方向。在一个初始提交可解析的队列中，当提供前一个草稿时，候选并未增加正确答案，但当草稿缺失时，候选增加了27个百分点。这些结果确立了生成文本的条件价值：失败的提交可以留下有用材料，其贡献取决于还提供了什么以及保留了什么。

articles.title: When Calibration Data Matter in Sub-4-Bit Language Model Quantization
articles.abstract: Low-bit post-training quantization reduces language-model memory but can sharply degrade downstream task accuracy. Calibration usually relies on generic text, but when task-informed data recover accuracy and which quantizers benefit remain poorly understood. We introduce FragCal-DC, which supplements generic text with training documents from task families with low retention of full-precision accuracy in a two-bit scan. We use a two- to four-bit sweep to locate functional regimes and four-seed calibration comparisons to evaluate six data-dependent methods across six dense models (1.7B-8B) and ten tasks. At their lowest tested functional bit widths, iterative SignRound V2 and OmniQuant improve at two bits, whereas single-pass GPTQ and AWQ show small mean responses at three bits. At two bits, SignRound V2 gains 1.83 percentage points in mean ten-task accuracy over generic-text calibration across six models. At 70 billion parameters, GPTQ and SignRound V2 both improve at two bits, with functional generic-calibration baselines. For two-bit SignRound V2, task-level controls show that recovery concentrates on families included in calibration, while incorrect answer designations retain about 90% of the mean accuracy gain. Changes in reconstruction error do not consistently track accuracy gains. These findings support task-informed calibration as a design principle for preserving downstream accuracy in low-bit quantization.

articles.titleCn: 当校准数据在亚4比特语言模型量化中发挥作用时
articles.abstractCn: 低比特后训练量化可以减少语言模型的内存，但可能会显著降低下游任务的准确性。校准通常依赖于通用文本，但当任务相关信息数据能够恢复准确性且哪些量化器受益尚不清楚时，情况就变得复杂。我们引入了FragCal-DC，它通过在两比特扫描中补充具有低全精度保留率的任务家族训练文档来增强通用文本。我们使用两到四比特的扫描来定位功能区域，并使用四种子校准比较来评估六个密集模型（1.7B-8B）和十个任务中的六个数据依赖方法。在最低测试的功能比特宽度下，迭代SignRound V2和OmniQuant在两比特时有所改进，而单次通过GPTQ和AWQ在三比特时显示出较小的平均响应。在六种模型中，SignRound V2在通用文本校准的基础上，在十项任务的平均准确性上提高了1.83个百分点。在700亿参数时，GPTQ和SignRound V2在两比特时均有改进，具有功能通用校准基线。对于两比特SignRound V2，任务级别的控制显示，恢复主要集中在校准中包含的家族，而错误答案的指定保留了约90%的平均准确性增益。重建误差的变化并不始终与准确性增益一致。这些发现支持任务相关信息校准作为在低比特量化中保持下游准确性的设计原则。

articles.title: System Prompts Affect Response Bias More Than Discriminability in LLM Safety
articles.abstract: Large language model safety evaluations often focus on a compliance-refusal tradeoff: models should refuse unsafe requests without refusing safe ones. We argue that this misses a broader form of prompt-conditioned task selection, where the same request can elicit different behaviors depending on the system prompt. We investigate this using a controlled evaluation crossing eight safety-task prompt families with three clarity levels across HarmBench, XSTest, and IHEval. Holding benchmark items fixed, we evaluate 13 models and use signal detection theory to distinguish two possibilities: whether models become better at telling safe from unsafe requests (discriminability), or simply more willing to refuse (response criterion). We find substantial differences in discriminability across models, but system prompts primarily shift the willingness to refuse, with smaller and less consistent effects on discriminability. Increasing prompt clarity makes models more willing to refuse without reliably improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe requests. Beyond refusal, prompt families also shift responses among six distinct behavioral policies, including clarification and safe help. Together, these findings show that system prompts primarily change how models respond to safety-relevant requests rather than consistently improving their ability to distinguish safe from unsafe ones.

articles.titleCn: 系统提示比判别性对大型语言模型安全性的响应偏差影响更大
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的安全评估通常关注合规性-拒绝性权衡：模型应拒绝不安全的请求，但不拒绝安全的请求。我们认为这忽略了更广泛的形式——提示条件下的任务选择，其中相同的请求可能因系统提示不同而引发不同行为。我们通过在HarmBench、XSTest和IHEval上进行的受控评估，交叉了八种安全任务提示类别和三种清晰度级别来研究这一问题。保持基准项目固定，我们评估了13个模型，并使用信号检测理论来区分两种可能性：模型是否更擅长区分安全与不安全的请求（区分度），或仅仅是更愿意拒绝（反应标准）。我们发现模型间存在显著的区分度差异，但系统提示主要改变了拒绝意愿，对区分度的影响较小且不一致。提高提示清晰度使模型更愿意拒绝，但并未可靠地提升其区分安全与不安全请求的能力。除了拒绝之外，提示类别还会在六种不同的行为策略（包括澄清和安全帮助）之间调整响应。这些发现表明，系统提示主要改变模型如何响应与安全相关的请求，而非持续提升其区分安全与不安全请求的能力。

articles.title: Beyond AUROC: Deployment-Aware Evaluation of Model-Internal Jailbreak Detectors
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in user-facing systems, where jailbreak attacks can bypass safety controls and induce harmful and policy-violating outputs. Recent model-internal detectors use hidden representations, gradients, or internal signals to identify such prompts, but their practical security value depends critically on behavior at low false-positive operating points rather than on area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) alone. We study two data dependencies that shape this behavior: calibration data, which determine the detection threshold, and reference data, which can influence detector scores. Across four model-internal detectors, four LLMs, and twelve jailbreak families, thresholds calibrated on curated benign prompts frequently fail to preserve their false-positive rate (FPR) budgets on real-user traffic. Recalibration improves false-positive control but reveals substantial family-level coverage gaps, including cases with high AUROC but low true-positive rate (TPR). Causal reference-set interventions show that changing reference composition can substantially alter family-level detection and that improving coverage of one attack family can reduce coverage of others. These findings show that calibration and reference data are part of a detector's security behavior. We therefore recommend evaluating model-internal jailbreak defenses using realized FPR on deployment-like traffic and per-family TPR at explicit low-FPR operating points, with AUROC used as a complementary ranking metric rather than the primary security measure.

articles.titleCn: 超越AUROC：面向部署的模型内部越狱检测评估
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地部署在面向用户系统中，其中越狱攻击可以绕过安全控制并诱导有害和政策违规的输出。近期的模型内部检测器使用隐藏表示、梯度或内部信号来识别此类提示，但它们实际安全价值的关键在于低误报率操作点的行为，而不仅仅依赖于受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。我们研究了塑造这种行为的两个数据依赖性：校准数据，它决定了检测阈值，以及参考数据，它可以影响检测器分数。在四个模型内部检测器、四个LLM和十二个越狱家族中，基于精选良性提示校准的阈值经常无法在真实用户流量中保持其误报率（FPR）预算。重新校准改善了误报控制，但揭示了显著的家族级覆盖差距，包括AUROC高但真阳性率（TPR）低的情况。因果参考集干预表明，改变参考组成可以显著改变家族级检测，并且提高一个攻击家族的覆盖范围可以减少其他家族的覆盖范围。这些发现表明，校准数据和参考数据是检测器安全行为的一部分。因此，我们建议使用部署类似流量上的实际FPR和在明确低FPR操作点上的每个家族TPR来评估模型内部越狱防御，并将AUROC用作补充排序指标，而不是主要安全指标。

articles.title: Room to Reconsider: Reply Length Decides Whether Pushback Makes Language Models Sycophantic or Self-Correcting
articles.abstract: Language models often abandon a correct answer when a user pushes back without giving a reason, and this behavior is usually studied as sycophancy to be suppressed. The same pushback, however, also leads models to revisit and sometimes repair a wrong answer. We measure both effects on multiple-choice questions from MMLU and ARC-Challenge with four open models from two families (Qwen3 1.7B, 4B and 8B, and OLMo-2 7B), reading the final answer exactly from option logits after a free-form reply. The reply budget changes the verdict. When Qwen3-4B may answer the challenge in at most 96 tokens, pushback leaves accuracy unchanged or slightly lower; with 1,024 tokens, it corrects 43% of its wrong answers and pushback raises accuracy by 5.7 points. Whether pushback helps overall follows a simple break-even rule in the cave and correction rates. Inside the model, caving can be partly predicted before the challenge: hidden states add about 0.04-0.06 AUROC over turn-1 confidence in three of our four probing runs. A probe trained only on self-correction cases predicts caving beyond confidence when replies are truncated, but not when the model can finish its reasoning. Activation steering never reduced caving selectively: where it worked, it suppressed self-correction as well. We conclude that sycophancy evaluations should allow full replies and report self-correction alongside caving.

articles.titleCn: 留有余地重新考虑：回复长度决定反驳使语言模型谄媚还是自我纠正
articles.abstractCn: 当用户无理由地提出质疑时，语言模型常常放弃正确答案，这种行为通常被视为需要抑制的奉承。然而，同样的质疑也会促使模型重新审视并有时修正错误答案。我们通过MMLU和ARC-Challenge的多项选择题，使用来自两个系列（Qwen3 1.7B、4B和8B，以及OLMo-2 7B）的四个开放模型，在自由回复后精确读取选项logits中的最终答案，测量了这两种效应。回复预算会改变结果。当Qwen3-4B最多用96个token回答挑战时，质疑不会改变或略微降低准确率；而用1,024个token时，它修正了43%的错误答案，质疑使准确率提高了5.7分。质疑是否有助于整体效果，在洞穴和修正率中遵循一个简单的盈亏平衡规则。在模型内部，洞穴行为可以在挑战之前部分预测：在四个探测运行中的三个里，隐藏状态比一轮置信度多增加了约0.04-0.06的AUROC。仅在自我修正案例上训练的探测器在回复被截断时预测到洞穴行为，但在模型能够完成推理时则不会。激活引导从未选择性地减少洞穴行为：在它起作用的地方，它也抑制了自我修正。我们得出结论，奉承评估应允许完整回复，并报告自我修正与洞穴行为。

articles.title: Building and Auditing Chemical Datasets with LLMs: A General LLM-as-a-Judge Framework Applied to Homogeneous Catalytic PET Depolymerisation
articles.abstract: Large language models can rapidly extract structured multivariate experimental data from the chemistry literature, yet verifying thousands of generated records without ground truth remains difficult. We present a general, citation-grounded extraction and verification methodology centered on an independent "LLM-as-a-judge", applied to the literature on homogeneous catalytic poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET) depolymerisation. In this pipeline, an extractor LLM generates schema-enforced records from research papers with citations to document chunks tagged with universally unique identifiers (UUIDs); an independent LLM judge then reads the full paper alongside each record, flags unsupported fields, and proposes cited corrections. Prompt ablations show that requiring chunk-level citations not only provides provenance down to specific paragraphs and tables but also improves extraction accuracy. Before deploying the judge at scale, we benchmarked it against manual evaluation on extractions from a hand-curated reference set of 295 ionic-liquid-catalysed PET glycolysis experiments. The judge agreed with human evaluation on 85.7% of reviewed records and was significantly more effective than a heuristic string-matching baseline at catching errors across related experiments. Deployed across 3,942 extracted records from 561 papers, the framework accepted 67.5% of them as written. Its proposed corrections concentrated on quantitative fields, where the extractor often conflated related experiments. We release the extracted dataset with the complete LLM judge audit logs, as well as the Chemistry Data Extractor Toolkit, an open-source application implementing this end-to-end pipeline in a code-free, browser-based environment for document parsing, customizable schema and prompt design, model-agnostic extraction and auditing, interactive provenance-highlighted review, and reproducible dataset bundling.
articles.titleCn: 使用大型语言模型构建和审计化学数据集：一种通用的“大型语言模型作为裁判”框架在均相催化PET解聚中的应用
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型能够快速从化学文献中提取结构化的多元实验数据，然而在没有真实数据的情况下验证数千条生成记录仍然困难。我们提出了一种基于独立"LLM作为裁判"的通用、引文验证的提取和验证方法，应用于均相催化聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）解聚的文献研究。在该流程中，提取器LLM从带有带有通用唯一标识符（UUID）标记的文档片段引用的研究论文中生成符合模式的记录；独立的LLM裁判随后阅读每条记录对应的完整论文，标记不支持的字段，并提出引用的修正。提示消融实验表明，要求片段级引用不仅提供了追溯到特定段落和表格的来源证明，还提高了提取的准确性。在将裁判大规模部署之前，我们将其与手动评估在295个手选离子液体催化PET醇解实验提取的数据上进行了基准测试。裁判在审查的85.7%的记录上与人工评估结果一致，并且在识别相关实验中的错误方面显著优于启发式字符串匹配基线。该框架在561篇论文中提取的3,942条记录中，接受了67.5%的记录原样。其提出的修正主要集中在定量字段，提取器经常混淆相关实验。我们发布了提取的数据集和完整的LLM裁判审计日志，以及化学数据提取工具包，这是一个开源应用程序，在无代码、基于浏览器的环境中实现了端到端流程，用于文档解析、可定制的模式和提示设计、模型无关的提取和审计、交互式来源高亮审查和可重复的数据集打包。

articles.title: MoTo: Mixture of Tokenizers Towards Fair Multilingual Language Modeling
articles.abstract: Large language models rely on a single tokenizer that is chosen at training time and fixed thereafter. Most tokenizers are trained on English-dominant corpora, making them under-serve morphologically rich and non-Latin-script languages, where they can produce fragmented representations, longer sequence lengths, and reduced information density during training. We propose Mixture of Tokenizers MoTo, a modular tokenization framework that trains dedicated per-language BPE tokenizers and composes them into a unified superset vocabulary, where tokens shared across languages are deduplicated into a common ID space. Each tokenizer maintains its own normalization policy, pre-tokenization rules, and vocabulary budget. Despite allocating significantly fewer entries to English, MoTo retains English performance while delivering consistent gains across 18 out of 21 typologically diverse languages spanning six scripts, with improvements most pronounced on morphologically complex and non-Latin-script languages that are systematically underserved by English-dominant tokenizer design. Our results suggest that modular subword tokenization is a practical and extensible alternative to monolithic tokenization for multilingual parity.

articles.titleCn: MoTo：面向公平多语言语言模型的分词器混合方法
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型依赖于在训练时选择并固定使用的单一分词器。大多数分词器基于以英语为主的语料库进行训练，这使得它们无法充分服务于形态丰富且非拉丁字母语言，在训练过程中这些语言会产生碎片化的表示、更长的序列长度和降低的信息密度。我们提出了混合分词器 MoTo，这是一个模块化分词框架，该框架为每种语言训练专门的 BPE 分词器，并将它们组合成一个统一的超集词汇表，其中跨语言共享的标记会被去重到一个公共的 ID 空间。每个分词器都保持其自身的规范化策略、预分词规则和词汇预算。尽管分配给英语的条目显著减少，MoTo 仍保持了英语的性能，同时在涵盖六种文字的21种类型多样语言中的18种语言上实现了持续的性能提升，其中形态复杂和非拉丁字母语言因英语主导的分词器设计而系统性地服务不足，这些语言的改进尤为显著。我们的结果表明，模块化子词分词是面向多语言均衡的、实用且可扩展的分词替代方案。
